thus:0.line: 'The locks are clean, *thus* our leak is someone we trust.'

sentences.en: The shutdown was done by someone with full access, *thus* it had to be a person on our own list.

tool:0.en: Zero had left one thing behind: a small folding blade, the kind used to strip wire. It was not a weapon. It was a *tool*, and it was placed dead-centre on the floor as a message. Grey Crow crouched over it without touching it. 'He wants us to know,' he said, 'that he was working.'

tool:0.line: 'This *tool* is a message — Zero finished something here tonight.'

sentences.en: It was a *tool*, and it was placed dead-centre on the floor as a message.

sentences.en: 'He wants us to know,' he said, 'that he was working.'

desire:0.en: Grey Crow slid a cracked data chip across the table. 'Take it or leave it.' I felt a sharp *desire* to leave, to walk out into the rain and forget Harbor City. But the chip held the only map to Zero's base. My hand moved before my head did.

sentences.cn: 警戒带是假的。

sentences.en: Someone wanted this zone empty.
sentences.cn: 有人想让这片区域空荡荡的。

sentences.en: I ducked under it and kept moving.
sentences.cn: 我低身钻过警戒带,继续往前。

material:1.en: Zero's crew had packed the old warehouse floor with *material* — coils of wire, blank circuit boards, stripped casings. Not weapons. Something stranger. Grey Crow said the parts alone meant nothing, but assembled in the right order they could rewrite a city's broadcast signal entirely.
material:1.cnHint: 仓库地板上堆满了各种____，灰鸦说这些东西组合起来能改写整座城市的广播信号。
material:1.hook: One casing still held a faint green glow.
material:1.line: 'This *material* is not for building — it is for erasing,' Grey Crow said quietly.

sentences.en: Zero's crew had packed the old warehouse floor with *material* — coils of wire, blank circuit boards, stripped casings.
Not weapons.
sentences.cn: 不是武器。

sentences.en: Something stranger.
sentences.cn: 什么更奇怪的东西。

sentences.en: Grey Crow said the parts alone meant nothing, but assembled in the right order they could rewrite a city's broadcast signal entirely.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦说这些零件单独毫无意义,但按正确的顺序组装起来,就能完全改写整座城市的广播信号。

pressure:1.en: Water burst from a cracked main under the avenue, and the *pressure* drove it high — a cold white wall across the road. I could not go back. Ali was on the far side, waving me through. I ran straight into the spray and did not stop.
pressure:1.cnHint: 大街地下水管爆裂，巨大的____把水柱冲上半空，我必须穿过去才能到达阿栗那边。
pressure:1.hook: Halfway through, something grabbed my wrist.
pressure:1.line: 'The *pressure* in this pipe has been rising for an hour — someone opened a valve,' Ali said.

sentences.en: Water burst from a cracked main under the avenue, and the *pressure* drove it high — a cold white wall across the road.
I could not go back.
sentences.cn: 我回不了头。

sentences.en: Ali was on the far side, waving me through.
sentences.cn: 阿栗在对岸向我挥手。

sentences.en: I ran straight into the spray and did not stop.
sentences.cn: 我直冲进水雾里,没有停下。

thus:1.en: The city grid ran on a single control node, *thus* killing that node would darken every district at once. I had read the report three times and not believed it. Now, standing in the dead street with rain on my face, I believed every word.
thus:1.cnHint: 城市电网只有一个控制节点，____一旦摧毁，整座城市就会陷入黑暗。
thus:1.hook: The node's address was already written on my hand.
thus:1.line: 'One node controls all power, and *thus* one cut ends the city,' Zero's voice said through the static.

sentences.en: The city grid ran on a single control node, *thus* killing that node would darken every district at once.
I had read the report three times and not believed it.
sentences.cn: 我读了三遍报告,还是不相信。

sentences.en: Now, standing in the dead street with rain on my face, I believed every word.
sentences.cn: 现在,站在死寂的街道上,雨水打在脸上,我相信了每一个字。

tool:1.en: Grey Crow pressed a small device into my palm — worn metal, no label. 'Your only *tool* tonight,' he said. It could read coded signals buried in street noise. Simple. Fragile. If I lost it, the mission was over. I closed my fingers tight around it.
tool:1.cnHint: 灰鸦交给我一件____，它是今晚解读隐藏信号的唯一手段。
tool:1.hook: The device buzzed once — it had already found something.
tool:1.line: 'Guard this *tool* with everything you have — there is no second one,' Grey Crow said.

sentences.en: Grey Crow pressed a small device into my palm — worn metal, no label.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦把一个小装置塞进我的掌心——磨损的金属,没有标签。

sentences.en: 'Your only *tool* tonight,' he said.
It could read coded signals buried in street noise.
sentences.cn: 它能解读隐藏在街道噪音中的编码信号。

sentences.en: Simple.
sentences.cn: 很简单。

sentences.en: Fragile.
sentences.cn: 很脆弱。

sentences.en: If I lost it, the mission was over.
sentences.cn: 要是我丢了它,任务就完了。

sentences.en: I closed my fingers tight around it.
sentences.cn: 我紧紧握住它。

international:1.en: The signal cut through the rain like a blade. Grey Crow pressed a cracked tablet into my hand. 'This *international* broadcast is being jammed from inside Harbor City,' he said. The screen showed a frozen map — every major city blacked out at the same hour. Someone had planned this.
international:1.cnHint: 灰鸦截获了一段遭到干扰的____广播，地图显示全球各大城市同时断电。
international:1.hook: The jam source was one block away.
international:1.line: 'This *international* signal did not go dark by accident.'

sentences.en: The signal cut through the rain like a blade.
sentences.cn: 信号在雨中如刀锋般划过。

sentences.en: Grey Crow pressed a cracked tablet into my hand.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦把一块裂纹的平板塞进我手里。

sentences.en: 'This *international* broadcast is being jammed from inside Harbor City,' he said.
The screen showed a frozen map — every major city blacked out at the same hour.
sentences.cn: 屏幕上是一张冻结的地图——每座主要城市在同一时刻被黑了出去。

sentences.en: Someone had planned this.
sentences.cn: 有人精心策划了这一切。

manage:1.en: Smoke poured from the relay tower. Ali yanked a junction box open and her fingers flew across the wires. 'I can *manage* a bypass — give me ninety seconds,' she said through gritted teeth. The backup grid flickered. Ninety seconds felt like a lifetime with Zero's drone circling above.
manage:1.cnHint: 阿栗设法对中继塔进行了应急处理，但零点的无人机正在头顶盘旋。
manage:1.hook: The drone's red eye locked onto Ali.
manage:1.line: 'I can *manage* this — just keep that drone off me.'

sentences.en: Smoke poured from the relay tower.
sentences.cn: 浓烟从中继塔冒出来。

sentences.en: Ali yanked a junction box open and her fingers flew across the wires.
sentences.cn: 阿栗一把拉开接线盒,手指在电线上飞快地动作。

sentences.en: 'I can *manage* a bypass — give me ninety seconds,' she said through gritted teeth.
The backup grid flickered.
sentences.cn: 备用网格闪烁起来。

sentences.en: Ninety seconds felt like a lifetime with Zero's drone circling above.
sentences.cn: 在零点的无人机在头顶盘旋的情况下,九十秒感觉像一辈子那么长。

outside:1.en: The blackout spread block by block. I stepped through a broken door into the cold. *Outside*, the street was a river of shadows — no traffic lights, no shop signs, no sound except rain and distant boots on wet stone. Someone was moving fast toward the relay tower.
outside:1.cnHint: 停电蔓延至整条街，叙述者走到____，发现黑暗中有人正快速靠近中继塔。
outside:1.hook: Those boots stopped right behind me.
outside:1.line: '*Outside* is the last place you should be tonight.'

sentences.en: The blackout spread block by block.
sentences.cn: 停电一块一块地蔓延开去。

sentences.en: I stepped through a broken door into the cold.
sentences.cn: 我踏进一扇破损的门,走进寒冷里。

sentences.en: *Outside*, the street was a river of shadows — no traffic lights, no shop signs, no sound except rain and distant boots on wet stone.
Someone was moving fast toward the relay tower.
sentences.cn: 有什么东西在向中继塔快速逼近。

fun:1.en: Zero's voice crackled over a stolen channel. 'Having *fun* in the dark, rookie?' The taunt was light, almost bored, but I heard the edge beneath it. He was watching me. I spun around. The alley was empty — just coded graffiti glowing faint blue on the wet wall.
fun:1.cnHint: 零点通过截获的频道嘲讽叙述者，暗示自己一直在监视着对方。
fun:1.hook: The blue glow spelled out my name.
fun:1.line: 'Having *fun* yet, rookie? The night is just starting.'

sentences.en: Zero's voice crackled over a stolen channel.
sentences.cn: 零点的声音在被盗频道里沙沙作响。

sentences.en: 'Having *fun* in the dark, rookie?'
The taunt was light, almost bored, but I heard the edge beneath it.
sentences.cn: 嘲讽听起来轻飘飘的,几乎很无聊,但我听出了底下的尖刻。

sentences.en: He was watching me.
sentences.cn: 他在监视我。

sentences.en: I spun around.
sentences.cn: 我转身。

sentences.en: The alley was empty — just coded graffiti glowing faint blue on the wet wall.
sentences.cn: 小巷空荡荡的——只有编码涂鸦在湿润的墙上发出微弱的蓝光。

reality:1.en: Grey Crow had warned me the city felt safe between blackouts. Standing under a dead streetlamp, the *reality* hit hard: Harbor City had no safe hours, only intervals between dangers. Rain collected in a cracked gutter. Somewhere above, a shutter banged. The next blackout was already counting down.
reality:1.cnHint: 灰鸦曾给过警告，而此刻叙述者终于直面了这座城市残酷的____。
reality:1.hook: My earpiece beeped — countdown: four minutes.
reality:1.line: 'The *reality* is that no corner of this city is safe.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow had warned me the city felt safe between blackouts.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦曾警告我,停电之间城市感觉是安全的。

sentences.en: Standing under a dead streetlamp, the *reality* hit hard: Harbor City had no safe hours, only intervals between dangers.
Rain collected in a cracked gutter.
sentences.cn: 雨水在裂开的沟槽里积聚。

sentences.en: Somewhere above, a shutter banged.
sentences.cn: 某处上方,百叶窗砰砰地敲打着。

sentences.en: The next blackout was already counting down.
sentences.cn: 下一次停电已经开始倒计时。

beyond:1.en: The relay tower's damage was *beyond* any simple repair — whole circuit boards were fused black. Ali knelt in the rain, her face grim. 'Someone didn't want this fixed fast,' she said quietly. Three blocks away, a second tower went dark. The blackout was not a failure. It was a message.
beyond:1.cnHint: 中继塔的损毁程度____了简单修复的范围，阿栗意识到这是有人蓄意为之。
beyond:1.hook: The message was addressed to us.
beyond:1.line: 'This damage is *beyond* anything a simple fault could cause.'

sentences.en: The relay tower's damage was *beyond* any simple repair — whole circuit boards were fused black.
Ali knelt in the rain, her face grim.
sentences.cn: 阿栗跪在雨里,脸色阴沉。

sentences.en: 'Someone didn't want this fixed fast,' she said quietly.
sentences.cn: 她轻声说,"有人不想让它快速修好。"

sentences.en: Three blocks away, a second tower went dark.
sentences.cn: 三个街区外,第二座塔暗了下去。

sentences.en: The blackout was not a failure.
sentences.cn: 停电不是故障。

sentences.en: It was a message.
sentences.cn: 这是一条信息。

completely:1.en: I turned on my torch. The coded graffiti that had lined this alley for weeks was *completely* gone — walls scrubbed clean, not even a ghost outline left. Ali touched the bare concrete and looked at me. 'They erased the map,' she said. Without that map, we had no route to the source.
completely:1.cnHint: 小巷里的暗语涂鸦被____清除，阿栗意识到那张隐藏的地图已经消失。
completely:1.hook: Ali pulled a fragment of paint from her pocket.
completely:1.line: 'The walls are *completely* clean — someone knew we would come.'

sentences.en: I turned on my torch.
sentences.cn: 我打开手电筒。

sentences.en: The coded graffiti that had lined this alley for weeks was *completely* gone — walls scrubbed clean, not even a ghost outline left.
Ali touched the bare concrete and looked at me.
sentences.cn: 阿栗摸了摸裸露的混凝土,看向我。

sentences.en: 'They erased the map,' she said.
sentences.cn: "他们抹掉了地图,"她说。

sentences.en: Without that map, we had no route to the source.
sentences.cn: 没有那张地图,我们就没办法找到源头。

advise:1.en: Grey Crow appeared at the alley's end, coat soaked, eyes sharp. 'I *advise* you to move before the second sweep,' he said, glancing at the rooftops. I didn't ask what a sweep meant. The way his jaw tightened told me enough. We ran without another word into the broken dark.
advise:1.cnHint: 灰鸦突然现身，____叙述者在第二轮搜查到来之前立刻撤离。
advise:1.hook: A spotlight swept the alley two seconds later.
advise:1.line: 'I *advise* you to leave this street right now.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow appeared at the alley's end, coat soaked, eyes sharp.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦出现在巷子的尽头，大衣湿透了，眼神锐利。

sentences.en: 'I *advise* you to move before the second sweep,' he said, glancing at the rooftops.
I didn't ask what a sweep meant.
sentences.cn: 我没问"扫荡"是什么意思。

sentences.en: The way his jaw tightened told me enough.
sentences.cn: 他下颌紧绷的样子已经说明了一切。

sentences.en: We ran without another word into the broken dark.
sentences.cn: 我们没有再说一句话，冲进了破碎的黑暗里。

describe:1.en: Rain hit the street like static. I pressed my back against a cold wall and watched Grey Crow draw slow circles in the air. 'Try to *describe* what you heard,' he said. I opened my mouth. Nothing came. Somewhere above us, a speaker crackled and went dead.
describe:1.cnHint: 乌鸦要我____出那段隐秘信号的声音，我却哑口无言。
describe:1.hook: The silence that followed was louder than any signal.
describe:1.line: '*Describe* exactly what you heard before the tower went dark.'

sentences.en: Rain hit the street like static.
sentences.cn: 雨砸在街道上，像静电噪音。

sentences.en: I pressed my back against a cold wall and watched Grey Crow draw slow circles in the air.
sentences.cn: 我的后背紧贴着冰冷的墙，看着灰鸦在空中缓缓画圈。

sentences.en: 'Try to *describe* what you heard,' he said.
I opened my mouth.
sentences.cn: 我张开嘴。

sentences.en: Nothing came.
sentences.cn: 什么都说不出来。

sentences.en: Somewhere above us, a speaker crackled and went dead.
sentences.cn: 我们头顶的某处，扬声器噼啪一声，然后没音了。

rest:1.en: Ali leaned against a broken lamp post, eyes shut. 'Take a *rest*,' I told her. She shook her head. Around us, Harbor City hummed low and wrong, like a machine running on the last of its power. The neon signs above us flickered once, then every light on the block died.
rest:1.cnHint: 阿里在街角短暂____，随即全街陷入黑暗。
rest:1.hook: Darkness swallowed the street before she could open her eyes.
rest:1.line: 'There is no time for *rest* — they are already moving.'

sentences.en: Ali leaned against a broken lamp post, eyes shut.
sentences.cn: 阿栗靠在一根断了的路灯柱上，眼睛闭着。

sentences.en: 'Take a *rest*,' I told her.
She shook her head.
sentences.cn: 她摇了摇头。

sentences.en: Around us, Harbor City hummed low and wrong, like a machine running on the last of its power.
sentences.cn: 港湾城在我们周围嗡嗡作响，声音低沉而诡异，像一台快要没电的机器。

sentences.en: The neon signs above us flickered once, then every light on the block died.
sentences.cn: 我们头顶的霓虹灯闪了一下，然后整条街的灯全灭了。

employer:1.en: Zero stepped out of the shadows, collar turned up against the rain. 'Your *employer* sent you here,' he said, not as a question. I said nothing. He slid a folded card across the wet pavement with the tip of his boot. The card had my name on it — and a price.
employer:1.cnHint: 零点暗示我的____早已将我的信息卖掉。
employer:1.hook: Someone had sold me out, and I knew exactly who.
employer:1.line: 'Your *employer* gave you up the moment you left the building.'

sentences.en: Zero stepped out of the shadows, collar turned up against the rain.
sentences.cn: 零点从阴影里走出来，竖起衣领挡雨。

sentences.en: 'Your *employer* sent you here,' he said, not as a question.
I said nothing.
sentences.cn: 我没有说话。

sentences.en: He slid a folded card across the wet pavement with the tip of his boot.
sentences.cn: 他用靴尖尖把一张折叠的卡片滑过湿漉漉的地面。

sentences.en: The card had my name on it — and a price.
sentences.cn: 卡片上写着我的名字——还有一个价格。

owner:1.en: The shop front was dark, glass cracked, the sign half-torn. Grey Crow pointed to the lock. 'The *owner* left in a hurry,' he said quietly. I knelt and looked closer. The lock had not been forced — it had been opened from inside, then the door pulled shut from outside.
owner:1.cnHint: 店铺____匆忙离去，留下的痕迹指向一个惊人真相。
owner:1.hook: Whoever left in such haste was running from something inside.
owner:1.line: 'The *owner* knew we were coming — that lock proves it.'

sentences.en: The shop front was dark, glass cracked, the sign half-torn.
sentences.cn: 店面是黑的，玻璃碎了，招牌半撕开。

sentences.en: Grey Crow pointed to the lock.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦指了指锁。

sentences.en: 'The *owner* left in a hurry,' he said quietly.
I knelt and looked closer.
sentences.cn: 我蹲下身仔细看。

sentences.en: The lock had not been forced — it had been opened from inside, then the door pulled shut from outside.
sentences.cn: 锁没有被撬开——是从里面打开的，然后从外面把门拉上。

gender:1.en: The coded graffiti covered the tunnel wall for twenty metres. Ali read it fast, moving her fingers along the lines. 'Whoever wrote this hid their *gender*, their name, everything,' she said. 'Only the signal remains.' I looked at the last symbol. It was still wet. The writer was close.
gender:1.cnHint: 涂鸦作者隐藏了自己的____，却留下了未干的墨迹。
gender:1.hook: Wet ink meant the writer had not yet reached the corner.
gender:1.line: 'They erased every trace — age, *gender*, even their footprint style.'

sentences.en: The coded graffiti covered the tunnel wall for twenty metres.
sentences.cn: 密码涂鸦覆盖了隧道墙壁二十来米。

sentences.en: Ali read it fast, moving her fingers along the lines.
sentences.cn: 阿栗快速读着，手指沿着线条滑动。

sentences.en: 'Whoever wrote this hid their *gender*, their name, everything,' she said.
'Only the signal remains.'
sentences.cn: '只有信号还在。'

sentences.en: I looked at the last symbol.
sentences.cn: 我看着最后一个符号。

sentences.en: It was still wet.
sentences.cn: 还是湿的。

sentences.en: The writer was close.
sentences.cn: 写字的人就在附近。

website:1.en: Grey Crow handed me a paper slip, old-style, hand-written. A single address. 'This *website* goes dark in six minutes,' he said. 'After that, the data is gone.' I had no device. I looked up at the public screen above the shuttered noodle stand. It was still on — barely.
website:1.cnHint: 乌鸦告诉我那个____六分钟后永久关闭，我必须马上行动。
website:1.hook: Six minutes, one screen, and the rain was getting heavier.
website:1.line: 'That *website* holds the list — six minutes and it vanishes forever.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow handed me a paper slip, old-style, hand-written.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦递给我一张纸条，老式的，手写的。

sentences.en: A single address.
sentences.cn: 只有一个地址。

sentences.en: 'This *website* goes dark in six minutes,' he said.
'After that, the data is gone.'
sentences.cn: '之后数据就消失了。'

sentences.en: I had no device.
sentences.cn: 我没有设备。

sentences.en: I looked up at the public screen above the shuttered noodle stand.
sentences.cn: 我抬头看着那个关闭的面馆上方的公共屏幕。

sentences.en: It was still on — barely.
sentences.cn: 还亮着——勉强。

emotional:1.en: Zero watched me from across the rain-slicked road, arms folded. 'You are getting *emotional*,' he called out, almost gentle. 'That is dangerous in this city.' I steadied my breath. He was right. Feelings were a signal too, and in Harbor City, every signal could be tracked.
emotional:1.cnHint: 零点警告我不要变得____，因为情绪在这座城市里是一种危险信号。
emotional:1.hook: I forced my face blank, but my hands would not stop shaking.
emotional:1.line: 'Stay cold — getting *emotional* out here will get you killed.'

sentences.en: Zero watched me from across the rain-slicked road, arms folded.
sentences.cn: 零点从雨湿的马路对面看着我，双臂交叉。

sentences.en: 'You are getting *emotional*,' he called out, almost gentle.
'That is dangerous in this city.'
sentences.cn: '那在这座城市里很危险。'

sentences.en: I steadied my breath.
sentences.cn: 我稳了稳呼吸。

sentences.en: He was right.
sentences.cn: 他说得对。

sentences.en: Feelings were a signal too, and in Harbor City, every signal could be tracked.
sentences.cn: 感情也是信号，在港湾城，每个信号都能被追踪。

training:1.en: Ali moved through the dark alley without a sound, each step placed with care. I struggled to keep up. 'Your *training* shows,' I whispered. She paused at the corner, held up one fist. We both froze. From the far end of the alley came the slow, steady sound of boots on wet stone.
training:1.cnHint: 阿里的____让她在黑暗巷道中行动自如，而我们前方出现了不明来者。
training:1.hook: The boots stopped — whoever it was now knew we were there.
training:1.line: 'My *training* taught me one thing: never freeze at the corner.'

sentences.en: Ali moved through the dark alley without a sound, each step placed with care.
sentences.cn: 阿栗无声地穿过黑暗的巷子，每一步都踩得很稳。

sentences.en: I struggled to keep up.
sentences.cn: 我费劲地跟上。

sentences.en: 'Your *training* shows,' I whispered.
She paused at the corner, held up one fist.
sentences.cn: 她在拐角处停下，举起一只拳头。

sentences.en: We both froze.
sentences.cn: 我们都僵住了。

sentences.en: From the far end of the alley came the slow, steady sound of boots on wet stone.
sentences.cn: 从巷子的另一头传来缓慢而稳定的脚步声——靴子踩在湿石头上。

consume:1.en: The blackout hit at midnight. Every screen in Harbor City went dark. I watched the emergency grid *consume* the last reserves of power — numbers dropping fast on my wrist display. Ali grabbed my arm. 'We have maybe four minutes,' she whispered. Somewhere above us, Zero was already moving.
consume:1.cnHint: 大停电袭来，备用电网正在迅速____最后的电力储备。
consume:1.hook: Four minutes — and the city's locks would open.
consume:1.line: 'Watch it *consume* everything before you can stop it.'

sentences.en: The blackout hit at midnight.
sentences.cn: 停电在午夜发生。

sentences.en: Every screen in Harbor City went dark.
sentences.cn: 港湾城的每块屏幕都黑了。

sentences.en: I watched the emergency grid *consume* the last reserves of power — numbers dropping fast on my wrist display.
Ali grabbed my arm.
sentences.cn: 阿栗抓住我的胳膊。

sentences.en: 'We have maybe four minutes,' she whispered.

sentences.en: Somewhere above us, Zero was already moving.

desire:1.en: Cold rain hit the pavement hard. I stood under a broken streetlight, scanning coded graffiti on the wall. Grey Crow had marked this spot. I felt a sharp *desire* to decode the message before Zero arrived — every second of delay was a second lost. My fingers moved fast.

desire:1.hook: Then the graffiti changed — someone was rewriting it live.
desire:1.line: 'I *desire* answers, not more riddles on a wet wall.'

meal:1.en: The night market stall was still open — one lonely vendor, steam rising from a clay pot. I had not eaten since morning. A *meal* here meant cover: two minutes of stillness in a crowd, enough to review the data chip Ali had slipped into my pocket.

meal:1.line: 'Eat your *meal* and stop looking over your shoulder.'

vegetable:1.hook: A shadow crossed the far end of the street and stopped.
vegetable:1.line: 'Stay behind the *vegetable* cart and do not move yet.'

adopt:1.en: Grey Crow stepped out of the doorway, collar up against the rain. 'You need to *adopt* a new route every night,' he said, voice flat. 'Zero maps your patterns. Walk the same block twice and you are already caught.' He pressed a folded card into my hand and was gone.

adopt:1.hook: I opened the card — it showed my route from last night.
adopt:1.line: '*Adopt* a new path tonight or do not come back at all.'

miss:1.en: A distant siren cut through the rain. I almost *missed* the small blue light blinking on the rooftop across the street — one long flash, two short. Ali's code for danger close. I ducked into the alcove beside me, back flat against wet concrete, breath held.

miss:1.hook: Boots scraped the pavement — someone had turned the corner.
miss:1.line: 'Do not *miss* the signal again or we both pay for it.'

yourself:1.en: Grey Crow's voice crackled through my earpiece, steady and cold. 'Trust *yourself* on this one — no backup, no map update, no second opinion. You read the signal, you choose the path.' The rain was heavier now. I looked at the two dark streets ahead and chose the left.

yourself:1.hook: The left street ended in a wall — and a waiting figure.
yourself:1.line: 'You only have *yourself* to rely on from this point forward.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow's voice crackled through my earpiece, steady and cold.

century:1.en: The old clock tower at Harbor Square had counted every hour for a full *century* — a hundred years of the city's noise and silence. Now it stood dark, its face cracked, power dead. Grey Crow said the encoded broadcast was hidden inside its signal drum. I started climbing.
century:1.cnHint: 港口广场的百年钟楼断电后成了谜，调查员开始攀爬，寻找隐藏其中一____的加密信号。
century:1.hook: Inside the drum, something was already transmitting.
century:1.line: 'This tower has kept secrets for a *century* — one more night..'

indeed:0.line: 'These coordinates are *indeed* a warning, not noise.'

launch:0.en: The basement server room hummed in the dark. Grey Crow pulled up a countdown on the cracked screen: forty seconds. 'They plan to *launch* the forbidden broadcast from this node,' he said quietly. I reached for the power switch. Grey Crow caught my wrist. 'Cut it now and every alarm in the city fires.'

trust:0.en: The door to the data vault required a voice key. Grey Crow said only one person knew it: Zero. 'You want me to ask my enemy for help,' I said. Grey Crow did not smile. 'I want you to decide how much *trust* is worth tonight.' The rain hammered the roof. Outside, boots were already on the stairs.

trust:0.hook: Zero's voice came through the wall before I could decide.
trust:0.line: '*Trust* is a weapon tonight — choose who holds it carefully.'

discussion:0.en: Ali and I sat under the one working light in the archive room. The *discussion* was short and cold: follow the signal north and risk the checkpoint, or decode the file here and lose two hours. Every minute we talked, Zero's team moved. I looked at Ali. She was already pulling on her coat.
discussion:0.cnHint: 在档案室里，调查员和阿栗的____简短而冷静，但每拖一分钟零点的队伍就更近一步。

extremely:0.en: The signal I intercepted was *extremely* faint — just four pulses under the building's background noise. Most scanners would miss it entirely. But I heard it, and I knew the pattern: it was Grey Crow's emergency code, sent from inside the locked room at the end of the hall. Someone had put him there. Someone who knew his code.

extremely:0.hook: Only one person besides me knew that emergency code.
extremely:0.line: 'The signal is *extremely* weak — he must be right below us.'

I sorted fast. The last chip hummed differently from the others. Not a data chip. A transmitter. Still active. Still broadcasting our location.

Beneath the random shapes, a *pattern* ran left to right: short mark, long mark, short mark — a code older than the city itself. Grey Crow had been here. He had left this. Which meant he had also known someone would be following him.

management:1.en: The neon sign above the dockyard gate flickered twice, then died. Ali pressed her back against the cold wall. 'The *management* of this port cuts power on purpose,' she whispered. 'Every third night. Like clockwork.' I checked my scanner. A pattern that careful meant someone very powerful was hiding something below the water.

management:1.line: 'The *management* here cuts power to hide what they ship at night.'

sentences.cn: 阿栗最先发现了信使——一个穿着灰色衣服的身影沿着高架走道向北冲刺。

sentences.en: 'We have to move,' she said.
sentences.cn: "我们得动起来，"她说。

sentences.en: The *race* was on: if that courier reached the relay node before us, every encrypted file would vanish from the city grid.
I ran.
sentences.cn: 我跑了起来。

sentences.en: The rain hit like static.
sentences.cn: 雨像静电一样敲打下来。

medical:1.en: The shelter door opened on a row of cots and cold light. A woman in a white coat looked up. I needed the records — *medical* files the city kept on every citizen who had heard the forbidden frequency. Those files were proof. They were also the reason three people had already disappeared.
medical:1.cnHint: 我闯入避难所，寻找那批____档案——它们是证据，也是危险的根源。
medical:1.hook: The woman in the white coat said, 'Those files died an hour ago.'
medical:1.line: 'The *medical* records name every witness,' Grey Crow said flatly.

sentences.en: The shelter door opened on a row of cots and cold light.
sentences.cn: 收容所的门打开，里面是一排行军床和冷白色的灯光。

sentences.en: A woman in a white coat looked up.
sentences.cn: 一个穿着白大褂的女人抬起头。

sentences.en: I needed the records — *medical* files the city kept on every citizen who had heard the forbidden frequency.
Those files were proof.
sentences.cn: 这些文件是证据。

sentences.en: They were also the reason three people had already disappeared.
sentences.cn: 它们也是三个人已经失踪的原因。

wear:1.en: Grey Crow stepped out of the shadow and I saw it then — the *wear* on his jacket, the frayed collar, the scuffed shoulder. He had been running longer than any of us. He handed me a small card without a word. On it was a frequency, handwritten, already half faded.
wear:1.cnHint: 灰鸦从阴影中走出，我注意到他外套上的____，他已经逃亡很久了。
wear:1.hook: The frequency on the card matched the one locked inside my skull.
wear:1.line: 'The *wear* on my coat? Each mark is a close call,' he said.

sentences.en: Grey Crow stepped out of the shadow and I saw it then — the *wear* on his jacket, the frayed collar, the scuffed shoulder.
He had been running longer than any of us.
sentences.cn: 他的奔逃比我们任何人都要久远。

sentences.en: He handed me a small card without a word.
sentences.cn: 他没有说一句话，递给我一张小卡片。

sentences.en: On it was a frequency, handwritten, already half faded.
sentences.cn: 卡片上用手写的是一个频率，字迹已经半褪色了。

climate:1.en: Harbor City had not seen stars in forty years. The *climate* above the towers was a permanent grey lid of cloud and chemical haze. Zero used it — no satellites, no outside eyes. Ali said the city was a sealed box, and someone had stolen the key. Tonight I believed her.
climate:1.cnHint: 港城的____让整座城市与外界隔绝——零点正是利用这一点藏匿行动。
climate:1.hook: Ali pointed up: through the haze, one star burned cold and clear.
climate:1.line: 'The *climate* here is Zero's best ally,' Ali said, eyes up.

sentences.en: Harbor City had not seen stars in forty years.
sentences.cn: 港城已经四十年没有看过星星了。

sentences.en: The *climate* above the towers was a permanent grey lid of cloud and chemical haze.
Zero used it — no satellites, no outside eyes.
sentences.cn: 零点利用了这一点——没有卫星，没有外界的眼睛。

sentences.en: Ali said the city was a sealed box, and someone had stolen the key.
sentences.cn: 阿栗说这座城市是一个密闭的盒子，有人偷走了钥匙。

sentences.en: Tonight I believed her.
sentences.cn: 今晚我相信她了。

head:1.en: At the end of the alley stood the *head* of the night watch — a broad figure in a black coat, face unreadable under the rain. Grey Crow had said to trust no one above rank three. This man was rank one. I stopped walking. My hand found the card in my pocket.
head:1.cnHint: 巷子尽头站着夜班的____，灰鸦曾警告我不要相信他。
head:1.hook: He smiled and said, 'I have been waiting for you since noon.'
head:1.line: 'The *head* of the watch works for Zero now,' Grey Crow said.

sentences.en: At the end of the alley stood the *head* of the night watch — a broad figure in a black coat, face unreadable under the rain.
Grey Crow had said to trust no one above rank three.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦说过不要相信三级以上的人。

sentences.en: This man was rank one.
sentences.cn: 这个人是一级。

sentences.en: I stopped walking.
sentences.cn: 我停止了脚步。

sentences.en: My hand found the card in my pocket.
sentences.cn: 我的手在口袋里摸到了那张卡片。

return:1.en: The rain hit the street like static noise. I stood outside Grid Station Nine, watching the power die block by block. Grey Crow had warned me: once the grid failed, there was no *return* to the safe route. The coded signal I needed was already fading into the dark.
return:1.cnHint: 停电后，我意识到通往安全路线的____已经断绝。
return:1.hook: Behind me, footsteps matched mine, step for step.
return:1.line: 'There is no *return* once the lights go out,' Grey Crow said.

sentences.en: The rain hit the street like static noise.
sentences.cn: 雨像静电噪音一样打在街道上。

sentences.en: I stood outside Grid Station Nine, watching the power die block by block.
sentences.cn: 我站在九号电网站外，看着电力一个街区接一个街区地熄灭。

sentences.en: Grey Crow had warned me: once the grid failed, there was no *return* to the safe route.
The coded signal I needed was already fading into the dark.
sentences.cn: 我需要的密码信号已经消褪在黑暗中了。

remove:1.en: Zero had tagged the wall with glowing graffiti — a false map designed to trap anyone who followed it. I had two minutes to *remove* the decoy marker before the patrol drone circled back. My fingers found the edge of the tag. The paint was still wet.
remove:1.cnHint: 我必须在无人机返回前____墙上那个虚假标记。
remove:1.hook: The drone's hum grew louder, closer than it should be.
remove:1.line: '*Remove* that marker now, or we both end up in a cage,' Ali said.

sentences.en: Zero had tagged the wall with glowing graffiti — a false map designed to trap anyone who followed it.
sentences.cn: 零点在墙上留下了发光的涂鸦——一张设计来陷阱任何跟踪者的假地图。

sentences.en: I had two minutes to *remove* the decoy marker before the patrol drone circled back.
My fingers found the edge of the tag.
sentences.cn: 我的手指找到了标签的边缘。

sentences.en: The paint was still wet.
sentences.cn: 油漆还是湿的。

colleague:1.en: The street was empty except for one figure leaning against a broken lamp post. I almost walked past before I recognized the jacket — grey, patched at the left shoulder. It was Ali, my *colleague*, the only other person who knew this dead-end alley was actually an exit.
colleague:1.cnHint: 在死胡同里，我认出了我的____，他知道这里其实是出口。
colleague:1.hook: Ali turned, and his eyes told me we were not alone.
colleague:1.line: 'A *colleague* who shows up in the dark is either brave or followed,' Ali said.

sentences.en: The street was empty except for one figure leaning against a broken lamp post.
sentences.cn: 街道是空的，除了一个身影靠在一盏破碎的灯柱上。

sentences.en: I almost walked past before I recognized the jacket — grey, patched at the left shoulder.
sentences.cn: 我差点走过去，才认出那件夹克——灰色的，左肩打了补丁。

sentences.en: It was Ali, my *colleague*, the only other person who knew this dead-end alley was actually an exit.

normal:1.en: The checkpoint scanner swept the crowd with a blue beam. Everyone held still. I kept my face *normal* — calm, bored, just another citizen caught in the blackout. Inside my coat pocket, the stolen data chip felt as heavy as a stone. The beam passed over me.
normal:1.cnHint: 我努力保持____的表情，穿过检查站的扫描光束。
normal:1.hook: Then the scanner stopped and reversed, locking onto me.
normal:1.line: 'Look *normal*, walk slow, and do not stop for anything,' Grey Crow said.

sentences.en: The checkpoint scanner swept the crowd with a blue beam.
sentences.cn: 检查站的扫描仪用蓝色光束扫过人群。

sentences.en: Everyone held still.
sentences.cn: 所有人都静止不动。

sentences.en: I kept my face *normal* — calm, bored, just another citizen caught in the blackout.
Inside my coat pocket, the stolen data chip felt as heavy as a stone.
sentences.cn: 我皮夹克的内袋里，被盗的数据芯片沉甸甸的，像一块石头。

sentences.en: The beam passed over me.
sentences.cn: 光束从我身上扫过。

succeed:1.en: Three teams had tried to crack the broadcast tower's lock before us. None of them made it past the second gate. Ali looked at me across the wet street and said if we did not *succeed* tonight, the hidden channel would go silent forever. I stepped forward.
succeed:1.cnHint: 我们必须今晚____，否则那个秘密频道将永远消失。
succeed:1.hook: The second gate clicked open — then an alarm split the air.
succeed:1.line: 'We *succeed* tonight, or nobody does,' Ali said, eyes steady.

sentences.en: Three teams had tried to crack the broadcast tower's lock before us.
sentences.cn: 在我们之前，已经有三支队伍试过破解那座广播塔的锁。

sentences.en: None of them made it past the second gate.
sentences.cn: 他们都没能冲过第二道门。

sentences.en: Ali looked at me across the wet street and said if we did not *succeed* tonight, the hidden channel would go silent forever.
I stepped forward.
sentences.cn: 我向前迈进。

image:1.en: The cracked screen on the alley wall flickered once and showed a face — sharp, pale, unmistakable. Zero's *image* stared out from every dead monitor on the block, a broadcast no one had authorized. It lasted four seconds. Then the screens went black and the rain kept falling.
image:1.cnHint: 零点的____突然出现在街道上所有失效的屏幕上。
image:1.hook: In those four seconds, Zero had mouthed a single word at me.
image:1.line: 'That *image* is a message meant for you alone,' Grey Crow said quietly.

sentences.en: The cracked screen on the alley wall flickered once and showed a face — sharp, pale, unmistakable.
sentences.cn: 小巷墙上那块裂纹屏幕闪烁了一下，显出一张脸——棱角分明，苍白得可怕，绝对是他。

sentences.en: Zero's *image* stared out from every dead monitor on the block, a broadcast no one had authorized.
It lasted four seconds.
sentences.cn: 只亮了四秒钟。

sentences.en: Then the screens went black and the rain kept falling.
sentences.cn: 然后屏幕全黑了，雨还在下。

ourselves:1.en: The patrol rounded the corner and we pressed flat against the cold wall. No backup, no signal, no way out except forward. We had put *ourselves* in this position by trusting a map that turned out to be bait. Ali's breath made small clouds in the night air.
ourselves:1.cnHint: 我们把____置于险境，因为我们相信了一张假地图。
ourselves:1.hook: The patrol stopped directly in front of our hiding spot.

sentences.en: The patrol rounded the corner and we pressed flat against the cold wall.
sentences.cn: 巡逻队从街角转过来，我们贴紧了冰冷的墙壁。

sentences.en: No backup, no signal, no way out except forward.
sentences.cn: 没有援兵，没有信号，唯一的出路就是继续往前。

sentences.en: We had put *ourselves* in this position by trusting a map that turned out to be bait.
Ali's breath made small clouds in the night air.
sentences.cn: 阿栗的呼吸在夜里冒出小小的水汽。

catch:1.en: Zero was fast, but the wet cobblestones slowed everyone equally. I pushed harder, closing the gap metre by metre through the dark arcade of shuttered stalls. I had one chance to *catch* Zero before the next blackout zone swallowed the signal trail completely. My hand reached out.
catch:1.cnHint: 我在黑暗的街道上全力追赶，试图____零点。
catch:1.hook: My fingers closed on fabric — but the face that turned was not Zero's.
catch:1.line: '*Catch* Zero tonight, or lose the trail for good,' Grey Crow said.

sentences.en: Zero was fast, but the wet cobblestones slowed everyone equally.
sentences.cn: 零点很快，但湿漉漉的鹅卵石让每个人都慢了下来。

sentences.en: I pushed harder, closing the gap metre by metre through the dark arcade of shuttered stalls.
sentences.cn: 我加快速度，在漆黑的拱形商店街里，一米一米地缩小距离。

sentences.en: I had one chance to *catch* Zero before the next blackout zone swallowed the signal trail completely.
My hand reached out.
sentences.cn: 我的手伸了出去。

mistake:1.en: Rain hammered the street outside the old signal tower. I spotted the coded graffiti too late — turning left had been a *mistake*. Zero's trap was already closing. Grey Crow's voice crackled in my earpiece: 'Wrong block. Move now.' The neon signs above me flickered and died.
mistake:1.cnHint: 我在信号塔外的街道上走错了方向，意识到自己犯了____。
mistake:1.hook: The lights went out, and footsteps closed in fast.
mistake:1.line: 'That *mistake* just cost us three minutes — run.'

sentences.en: Rain hammered the street outside the old signal tower.
sentences.cn: 雨砸在老信号塔外的街道上。

sentences.en: I spotted the coded graffiti too late — turning left had been a *mistake*.
Zero's trap was already closing.
sentences.cn: 零点的陷阱已经在收网。

sentences.en: Grey Crow's voice crackled in my earpiece: 'Wrong block.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦的声音在我的耳机里劈啪作响："走错街道了。

sentences.en: Move now.'
sentences.cn: 马上离开。"

sentences.en: The neon signs above me flickered and died.
sentences.cn: 我头顶的霓虹灯闪烁了一下，熄灭了。

staff:1.en: The power grid substation sat dark on the corner of Fifth and Rain Street. Every member of the *staff* had evacuated when the blackout hit — every member except one. A single light moved behind the frosted glass. Ali grabbed my sleeve and pulled me into the shadow of a doorway.
staff:1.cnHint: 变电站的____几乎全部撤离，但有一个人留了下来。
staff:1.hook: Whoever stayed behind was not supposed to be there.
staff:1.line: 'The *staff* all left — so who is that shadow?'

sentences.en: The power grid substation sat dark on the corner of Fifth and Rain Street.
sentences.cn: 电网变电站黑漆漆地坐在第五街和雨街的交角。

sentences.en: Every member of the *staff* had evacuated when the blackout hit — every member except one.
A single light moved behind the frosted glass.
sentences.cn: 一盏孤独的灯在磨砂玻璃后面移动。

sentences.en: Ali grabbed my sleeve and pulled me into the shadow of a doorway.
sentences.cn: 阿栗抓住我的袖子，把我拽进了一扇门廊的阴影里。

enhance:1.en: Grey Crow met me under the broken overpass, rain bouncing off the concrete. He pressed a small chip into my hand. 'This will *enhance* your scanner — you will hear signals two blocks further out.' I looked at the chip. It was stamped with Zero's symbol. I almost dropped it.
enhance:1.cnHint: 引路人给了我一枚芯片，据说能____我的扫描仪，但芯片上有可疑标记。
enhance:1.hook: Trusting that chip could be the last thing I ever did.
enhance:1.line: 'It will *enhance* your range — but the cost may surprise you.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow met me under the broken overpass, rain bouncing off the concrete.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦在破损的高架桥下等我，雨水在混凝土上跳跃。

sentences.en: He pressed a small chip into my hand.
sentences.cn: 他把一枚小芯片塞进了我的手心。

sentences.en: 'This will *enhance* your scanner — you will hear signals two blocks further out.'
I looked at the chip.
sentences.cn: 我看着那枚芯片。

sentences.en: It was stamped with Zero's symbol.
sentences.cn: 它上面刻着零点的符号。

sentences.en: I almost dropped it.
sentences.cn: 我差点把它掉了。

famous:1.en: The corner of Harbor and Ninth was *famous* for its underground broadcast wall — every hacker in the city had tagged it at least once. Tonight the wall was blank and white, freshly painted over. Ali stood staring at it, her face pale under the blue emergency lights. Something important had been erased.
famous:1.cnHint: 那面在黑客圈里____的涂鸦墙今晚被人粉刷一空。
famous:1.hook: What they painted over was the only map we had.
famous:1.line: 'This wall was *famous* — now it is just a warning.'

sentences.en: The corner of Harbor and Ninth was *famous* for its underground broadcast wall — every hacker in the city had tagged it at least once.
Tonight the wall was blank and white, freshly painted over.
sentences.cn: 今晚那面墙是空白的，刚刚粉刷过的白墙。

sentences.en: Ali stood staring at it, her face pale under the blue emergency lights.
sentences.cn: 阿栗站在那儿盯着看，她的脸在蓝色应急灯下苍白得吓人。

sentences.en: Something important had been erased.
sentences.cn: 有什么重要的东西被抹掉了。

project:1.en: I found the blueprint taped inside a hollow lamp post near the transit hub. The label read: *Project* Nightfall. Twelve city blocks. Full blackout. Scheduled for midnight. My hands were steady but my mind was not. This was not a test run — this was the real plan, and we had forty minutes.
project:1.cnHint: 我在路灯柱内发现了一份计划书，揭示了一个代号为____夜幕的大规模断电行动。
project:1.hook: Forty minutes to stop a blackout that would swallow the city.
project:1.line: '*Project* Nightfall is live — we are already behind.'

sentences.en: I found the blueprint taped inside a hollow lamp post near the transit hub.
sentences.cn: 我在运输枢纽附近的一盏空心灯柱里找到了贴着的蓝图。

sentences.en: The label read: *Project* Nightfall.
Twelve city blocks.
sentences.cn: 十二个街区。

sentences.en: Full blackout.
sentences.cn: 完全停电。

sentences.en: Scheduled for midnight.
sentences.cn: 午夜启动。

sentences.en: My hands were steady but my mind was not.
sentences.cn: 我的手很稳，但脑子不稳。

sentences.en: This was not a test run — this was the real plan, and we had forty minutes.
sentences.cn: 这不是演习——这是真正的计划，我们还有四十分钟。

record:1.en: Zero had left a small audio device wedged in the grate of the storm drain. I played it back. His voice was calm, almost bored. 'I keep a *record* of every move you make,' it said. Every corner I had turned tonight was on that recording. He had been watching since I left the station.
record:1.cnHint: 零点在排水沟里留下了一段录音，说他掌握着我行动的完整____。
record:1.hook: If he had every move, he already knew where I was going.
record:1.line: 'I keep a *record* — and tonight you gave me a long one.'

sentences.en: Zero had left a small audio device wedged in the grate of the storm drain.
sentences.cn: 零点在暴雨下水道的栅栏里塞了一个小型音频装置。

sentences.en: I played it back.
sentences.cn: 我放了出来。

sentences.en: His voice was calm, almost bored.
sentences.cn: 他的声音很冷静，甚至有点无聊。

sentences.en: 'I keep a *record* of every move you make,' it said.
Every corner I had turned tonight was on that recording.
sentences.cn: 我今晚转过的每一个角都被录了下来。

sentences.en: He had been watching since I left the station.
sentences.cn: 从我离开车站开始，他就在监视我。

regular:1.en: The tram stop at Block Seven looked normal at first. Then I noticed it: the *regular* night patrol was gone. No officers, no drones, no sweep lights cutting through the rain. Ali whispered that the patrol had been cancelled three hours ago — quietly, with no public notice. Someone with authority had cleared the street on purpose.
regular:1.cnHint: 七号街区的____夜间巡逻队今晚神秘消失，有人故意清空了这片区域。
regular:1.hook: An empty patrol route meant someone wanted no witnesses.
regular:1.line: 'The *regular* patrol is gone — this block is wide open.'

sentences.en: The tram stop at Block Seven looked normal at first.
sentences.cn: 第七街区的电车站起初看起来很正常。

sentences.en: Then I noticed it: the *regular* night patrol was gone.
No officers, no drones, no sweep lights cutting through the rain.
sentences.cn: 没有巡捕，没有无人机，没有扫描灯在雨里切割。

sentences.en: Ali whispered that the patrol had been cancelled three hours ago — quietly, with no public notice.
sentences.cn: 阿栗小声说巡逻三小时前就被取消了——悄无声息，没有公开通知。

sentences.en: Someone with authority had cleared the street on purpose.
sentences.cn: 有人用职权清空了这条街，那是故意的。

security:1.en: The gate to the harbor freight yard hung open. I checked the panel — every *security* lock had been disengaged from the inside, one by one, in the past hour. Grey Crow crouched beside me, reading the log. 'Whoever did this knew the codes,' he said quietly. The fog rolled in off the black water.
security:1.cnHint: 货运码头大门敞开，所有____锁都已从内部逐一解除。
security:1.hook: Only three people knew those codes, and I was one of them.
security:1.line: 'Every *security* lock is open — someone beat us here.'

sentences.en: The gate to the harbor freight yard hung open.
sentences.cn: 港口货运场的大门敞开着。

sentences.en: I checked the panel — every *security* lock had been disengaged from the inside, one by one, in the past hour.
Grey Crow crouched beside me, reading the log.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦蹲在我身边，查看日志。

sentences.en: 'Whoever did this knew the codes,' he said quietly.
sentences.cn: "做这事儿的人懂代码，"他轻声说。

sentences.en: The fog rolled in off the black water.
sentences.cn: 黑水上的雾气翻滚涌来。

whatever:1.en: The rain hit the street like static noise. Grey Crow handed me a cracked data chip. 'Take it,' he said. '*Whatever* signal you find on that chip, follow it. No questions.' I slipped it into my coat pocket and stepped into the neon dark alone.
whatever:1.cnHint: 灰鸦交给我一块破损的数据芯片，告诉我____信号都要追踪。
whatever:1.hook: The chip began to vibrate before I even reached the corner.
whatever:1.line: '*Whatever* you hear on that chip, do not stop moving.'

sentences.en: The rain hit the street like static noise.
sentences.cn: 雨像静噪一样敲打着街道。

sentences.en: Grey Crow handed me a cracked data chip.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦递给我一块裂开的数据芯片。

sentences.en: 'Take it,' he said. '*Whatever* signal you find on that chip, follow it.
No questions.'
sentences.cn: 没有疑问。

sentences.en: I slipped it into my coat pocket and stepped into the neon dark alone.
sentences.cn: 我把它塞进外套口袋，独自踏入霓虹色的黑暗。

predict:1.en: I stood at the mouth of an alley off Central Road. Grey Crow had told me to watch the coded signs on the walls. 'I can *predict* the next blackout zone,' he said quietly, tracing a symbol with one finger. The pattern was already spreading north.
predict:1.cnHint: 灰鸦观察墙上的暗号，声称能____下一个断电区域。
predict:1.hook: Three blocks north, every light went dead at once.
predict:1.line: 'I can *predict* exactly where the dark will fall next.'

sentences.en: I stood at the mouth of an alley off Central Road.
sentences.cn: 我站在中央路边一条巷子的入口。

sentences.en: Grey Crow had told me to watch the coded signs on the walls.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦让我注意墙上的密码符号。

sentences.en: 'I can *predict* the next blackout zone,' he said quietly, tracing a symbol with one finger.
The pattern was already spreading north.
sentences.cn: 图案已经向北扩散。

road:1.en: Zero's signal cut across every channel at midnight. Ali and I tracked it to a broken stretch of *road* outside the east grid, where the street lamps had never worked and the rain pooled black between the cracks. Something moved in the water ahead.
road:1.cnHint: 我和阿栗追踪零点的信号，来到东区电网外一段破败的____上。
road:1.hook: The shape in the water stood up slowly and turned around.
road:1.line: 'This *road* is Zero's territory — every step here is a trap.'

sentences.en: Zero's signal cut across every channel at midnight.
sentences.cn: 零点的信号在午夜穿过每个频道。

sentences.en: Ali and I tracked it to a broken stretch of *road* outside the east grid, where the street lamps had never worked and the rain pooled black between the cracks.
Something moved in the water ahead.
sentences.cn: 前面水里有东西在动。

solution:1.en: The city's east gate screen was blank. Ali knelt beside the access panel, fingers flying. 'I have a *solution*,' she said, pulling two loose wires apart and crossing them with a thin strip of foil. The screen flickered, then showed a single line of coordinates.
solution:1.cnHint: 阿栗在东门接入面板前找到了____，屏幕上随即显示出一串坐标。
solution:1.hook: The coordinates pointed directly to Zero's last known location.
solution:1.line: 'My *solution* will work, but we have about thirty seconds left.'

sentences.en: The city's east gate screen was blank.
sentences.cn: 城市东门的屏幕是黑的。

sentences.en: Ali knelt beside the access panel, fingers flying.
sentences.cn: 阿栗跪在接入面板旁，手指飞速移动。

sentences.en: 'I have a *solution*,' she said, pulling two loose wires apart and crossing them with a thin strip of foil.
The screen flickered, then showed a single line of coordinates.

total:1.en: Grey Crow's map showed the blackout zone in red. The *total* area covered twelve blocks — every power node inside was dark, every camera dead. 'Zero planned this,' Grey Crow said, folding the map with sharp, careful creases. I believed him.
total:1.cnHint: 停电区域____面积覆盖十二个街区，灰鸦断定这是零点的计划。
total:1.hook: Then Grey Crow's own signal light blinked out without warning.
total:1.line: 'The *total* blackout area is bigger than anything Zero tried before.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow's map showed the blackout zone in red.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦的地图用红色标出了停电区。

sentences.en: The *total* area covered twelve blocks — every power node inside was dark, every camera dead.
'Zero planned this,' Grey Crow said, folding the map with sharp, careful creases.
sentences.cn: 零点计划了这一切，灰鸦说，用尖锐、仔细的折痕折起地图。

sentences.en: I believed him.
sentences.cn: 我相信他。

fail:1.en: I pushed the receiver against the iron post and pressed the key. Nothing. I tried again. The old broadcast tower had begun to *fail*, its base eaten through by years of acid rain. Ali grabbed my arm. Above us, the tower let out a low groan.
fail:1.cnHint: 老广播塔因常年腐蚀开始____，塔身发出低沉的呻吟声。
fail:1.hook: The groan became a crack, and the tower started to lean.
fail:1.line: 'If this tower *fails* now, the signal dies and so do we.'

sentences.en: I pushed the receiver against the iron post and pressed the key.
sentences.cn: 我把接收器贴在铁柱上，按下按键。

sentences.en: Nothing.
sentences.cn: 什么都没有。

sentences.en: I tried again.
sentences.cn: 我又试了一次。

sentences.en: The old broadcast tower had begun to *fail*, its base eaten through by years of acid rain.
Ali grabbed my arm.
sentences.cn: 阿栗抓住我的胳膊。

sentences.en: Above us, the tower let out a low groan.
sentences.cn: 我们头顶上，塔发出了一声低沉的呻吟。

function:1.en: The street terminal at Gate Seven was still running on backup power. I pressed my palm to the screen. 'Its main *function* is to log every person who passes,' Ali said beside me, watching the old machine hum and blink. My name appeared in the log — dated three days from now.
function:1.cnHint: 七号门的街头终端还在运行，它的____是记录每个经过者，但屏幕上出现了我未来的名字。
function:1.hook: My future entry read: 'Access denied — subject not found.'
function:1.line: 'Its only *function* now is to show us who Zero is watching.'

sentences.en: The street terminal at Gate Seven was still running on backup power.
sentences.cn: 七号门的街道终端仍在备用电源上运行。

sentences.en: I pressed my palm to the screen.
sentences.cn: 我把手掌贴到屏幕上。

My name appeared in the log — dated three days from now.

method:1.en: Zero had blocked every standard route. I circled back to where Grey Crow waited under a dead lamp. 'There is one *method* left,' he said, drawing a short line on the wet pavement with his boot tip. 'Go under the grid, not through it.' I stared at the line.
method:1.cnHint: 所有常规路线都被零点封锁，灰鸦提出了最后一个____。
method:1.hook: Under the grid meant the old flood tunnels — and whatever lived there.
method:1.line: 'This *method* is dangerous, but it is the only path still open.'

sentences.en: Zero had blocked every standard route.
sentences.cn: 零点封锁了所有标准路线。

sentences.en: I circled back to where Grey Crow waited under a dead lamp.
sentences.cn: 我绕回灰鸦在一盏死灯下等待的地方。

sentences.en: 'There is one *method* left,' he said, drawing a short line on the wet pavement with his boot tip.
'Go under the grid, not through it.'
sentences.cn: 从网格下面走，别从网格上面走。

sentences.en: I stared at the line.
sentences.cn: 我盯着那条线。

join:1.en: Rain hammered the street outside Sector Nine. Grey Crow crouched beside a broken signal post and held out a wire. 'You have to *join* these two cables,' he said, his voice low. The lights of the whole block depended on this one connection. My hands were steady. The city was not.
join:1.cnHint: 灰鸦要求我把两根电缆____在一起，整个街区的电力全靠这一步。
join:1.hook: The wire sparked — and something in the dark moved.
join:1.line: 'You have to *join* these two cables, or the whole block goes dark.'

sentences.en: Rain hammered the street outside Sector Nine.
sentences.cn: 雨猛烈地敲打着九号区外的街道。

sentences.en: Grey Crow crouched beside a broken signal post and held out a wire.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦蹲在一根破损的信号柱旁，递出一根电线。

sentences.en: 'You have to *join* these two cables,' he said, his voice low.
The lights of the whole block depended on this one connection.
sentences.cn: 整个街区的灯都取决于这一个连接。

sentences.en: My hands were steady.
sentences.cn: 我的手很稳。

sentences.en: The city was not.
sentences.cn: 但城市不稳。

significant:1.en: Zero stood under a dead streetlamp, arms crossed. He had changed the route — a small shift on the map, but Grey Crow called it *significant*. 'That path leads past the relay tower,' Ali whispered beside me. One detour. One tower. The night suddenly felt much heavier than before.
significant:1.cnHint: 零点改变了路线，灰鸦认为这个变化____，因为那条路经过信号塔。
significant:1.hook: Ali grabbed my sleeve — someone was already at the tower.
significant:1.line: 'That change is *significant* — it leads straight to the relay tower.'

sentences.en: Zero stood under a dead streetlamp, arms crossed.
sentences.cn: 零点站在一盏死灯下，双臂交叉。

sentences.en: He had changed the route — a small shift on the map, but Grey Crow called it *significant*.
'That path leads past the relay tower,' Ali whispered beside me.

sentences.en: One detour.

sentences.en: One tower.
sentences.cn: 一座塔。

sentences.en: The night suddenly felt much heavier than before.
sentences.cn: 夜晚突然变得沉重得多了。

step:1.en: The alley was dark and the puddles deep. I counted every *step* toward the broadcast node, feeling the pavement shift under my boots. Grey Crow had said: move slow, stay quiet, trust the count. Forty steps to the junction. Thirty. Then a shadow crossed the far end of the alley.
step:1.cnHint: 我在黑暗小巷里数着每一个____，朝广播节点靠近，突然远处出现了一道影子。
step:1.hook: The shadow stopped — it had heard me.
step:1.line: 'Count every *step* — one wrong move and the sensors wake up.'

sentences.en: The alley was dark and the puddles deep.
sentences.cn: 巷子很黑，水坑很深。

Grey Crow had said: move slow, stay quiet, trust the count.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦说过：慢慢走，保持安静，相信数字。

sentences.en: Forty steps to the junction.

sentences.en: Thirty.
sentences.cn: 三十步。

sentences.en: Then a shadow crossed the far end of the alley.
sentences.cn: 然后一个影子掠过巷子的远端。

unique:1.en: Ali pressed a small chip into my palm. 'This signal is *unique*,' she said, eyes scanning the wet street. 'No other transmitter in Harbor City produces it.' If Zero captured the chip, he could imitate Grey Crow's voice on every channel. I closed my fist tight and ran.
unique:1.cnHint: 阿栗给了我一块芯片，说它的信号____，全城没有第二个，绝不能落入零点手中。

unique:1.line: 'This signal is *unique* — Zero can copy Grey Crow's voice with it.'

inside:1.en: The checkpoint gate was sealed. Grey Crow pointed to a rusted panel low on the wall. 'There is a relay switch *inside* that box,' he murmured. 'Trip it and the gate lifts.' Rain poured down my collar as I pried the panel open. The switch was gone. Someone had been here first.

inside:1.hook: A fresh wire lay coiled where the switch should have been.
inside:1.line: 'The relay switch is *inside* that box — trip it and the gate opens.'

sentences.en: The checkpoint gate was sealed.
sentences.cn: 检查站的大门被封死了。

sentences.cn: 灰鸦指向墙上一块生锈的低矮面板。

sentences.en: 'There is a relay switch *inside* that box,' he murmured.
'Trip it and the gate lifts.'

majority:1.en: Grey Crow spread a map across a crate. Red marks covered the grid. 'The *majority* of the signal towers in the east district are already dark,' he said quietly. Only three remained active. Zero needed just one more to complete his blackout grid. Ali and I had to reach it before dawn.

majority:1.hook: Dawn was two hours away — and we were still on foot.
majority:1.line: 'The *majority* of the towers are dark — we have only three left.'

notice:1.en: I almost walked past it. A small mark, chalk-white, scratched into the base of a signal post. Ali caught my arm. 'Did you *notice* that sign?' she asked. It matched the code Grey Crow had shown me in the safe house. Someone friendly — or someone pretending to be — had passed this way.

notice:1.line: 'Did you *notice* that mark? It matches Grey Crow's safe-house code.'

taste:1.en: The air near the substation had a sharp, metallic *taste*, the kind that comes before a high-voltage discharge. Grey Crow had warned me about it. I slowed, signalled Ali to stop. Twenty metres ahead, the ground was glowing faint blue along a long crack in the road. A trap, beautifully set.
taste:1.cnHint: 空气中有一种金属____，灰鸦说过那是高压放电前的信号，我们在发光的地面前停下了脚步。
taste:1.hook: Ali pointed up — a drone hovered, silent and still.
taste:1.line: 'That metallic *taste* in the air means a discharge is about to fire.'

review:1.en: The alley wall was covered in coded graffiti. I stopped, rain soaking my collar, and did a quick *review* of every symbol Grey Crow had taught me. Three signs matched the warning pattern. Someone had written this message hours ago — and they knew I would come.
review:1.cnHint: 我在巷子里____着灰鸦教过的暗号，发现三个危险符号。

ahead:1.en: Fog rolled off the harbour. Grey Crow pointed to a broken streetlight two blocks *ahead*, its dead bulb blinking in a slow, coded rhythm. Ali grabbed my arm. The blink pattern spelled a single word in the old cipher — a word that had been illegal in Harbor City for six years.

ahead:1.hook: I already knew that word — it was my father's name.
ahead:1.line: 'Stay close,' Grey Crow said. 'There is danger *ahead* and it knows our faces.'

Ali grabbed my arm.

cheap:1.en: A street vendor shoved a data card into my hand. '*Cheap* signal, full range,' he whispered, eyes low. Ali shook her head — she had seen cards like this before. They looked like bargains but carried hidden tracking code, broadcasting your position to anyone willing to pay.

cheap:1.hook: The vendor was already gone — into the crowd, into the dark.
cheap:1.line: Ali said, 'Never trust a *cheap* card in a city that sells its own citizens.'

Ali shook her head — she had seen cards like this before.

critical:1.en: The power grid had been down for forty minutes. Grey Crow crouched by a junction box, fingers moving fast. 'This node is *critical*,' he said. Every encrypted broadcast in the east quarter ran through it. Whoever had cut the power had wanted silence — city-wide, deliberate silence.

critical:1.hook: Then his tool snapped, and the box went dark.
critical:1.line: 'This junction is *critical* — if it stays dead, our signal dies with it.'

Every encrypted broadcast in the east quarter ran through it.

motivate:1.en: Zero appeared at the far end of the bridge, coat wet, hands open. 'What could *motivate* a rookie like you to walk into a blackout alone?' he called across the empty road. His voice was calm. That calm was the most frightening thing I had heard all night.

motivate:1.hook: He already knew the answer — that was the trap.
motivate:1.line: Zero said, 'Tell me what can *motivate* you, and I will tell you who sent me.'

sentences.en: Zero appeared at the far end of the bridge, coat wet, hands open.

charge:1.en: A city patrol drone dropped low, its red eye locking onto me. The officer inside pressed a single button. '*Charge*: illegal signal access, zone four, time 23:14.' Ali pulled me left into a drainage arch. The official record now had my face. There was no erasing that.

charge:1.hook: The drone pivoted, slow and patient, and followed.
charge:1.line: Ali said, 'If they *charge* you tonight, Grey Crow cannot protect you from the courts.'

complex:1.line: Grey Crow said, 'The system is *complex*, but there is one wire that holds it all.'

itself:1.hook: But I had already memorised every word.
itself:1.line: 'The file destroyed *itself* — whoever sent this does not want a witness.'

sentences.cn: 广播穿过静电杂音然后停止了。

sentences.en: Grey Crow looked up.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦抬起头。

sentences.en: 'The message deleted *itself*,' he said quietly.
No trace, no echo, only a faint electric smell in the cold air.
sentences.cn: 冷空气中只有淡淡的电焦味。

sentences.en: I had heard of self-erasing code, but tonight was the first time it had been aimed at me.
sentences.cn: 我听说过自我删除的代码，但今晚是它第一次冲我来。

differ:1.en: The street lights died at midnight. Grey Crow pulled me into a doorway. 'Look at the two signals,' he whispered. I studied the coded graffiti on the wall and the pulse from the dead lamp above. They *differed* in rhythm — one was a warning, the other an answer.
differ:1.cnHint: 灰鸦让我比较墙上的两段信号，发现它们的节奏____。
differ:1.hook: Only one of them was meant for us.
differ:1.line: 'These two signals *differ* — one wants us to run.'

sentences.en: The street lights died at midnight.
sentences.cn: 街灯在午夜熄灭了。

sentences.en: Grey Crow pulled me into a doorway.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦把我拉进了一个门廊。

sentences.en: 'Look at the two signals,' he whispered.
sentences.cn: "看那两个信号，"他低声说。

sentences.en: I studied the coded graffiti on the wall and the pulse from the dead lamp above.
sentences.cn: 我研究了墙上的密码涂鸦和上面那盏死灯发出的脉冲。

sentences.en: They *differed* in rhythm — one was a warning, the other an answer.

shape:1.en: Rain hammered the plaza. A figure stood under the broken arch, perfectly still. I could not see a face, only a dark *shape* against the neon glow — wide shoulders, a long coat, one hand raised toward the camera grid above the gate.
shape:1.cnHint: 广场上，一个模糊的____出现在霓虹灯光后方，纹丝不动。
shape:1.hook: Then the shape raised its second hand — and the lights died.
shape:1.line: 'That *shape* by the arch — I have seen it before.'

sentences.en: Rain hammered the plaza.
sentences.cn: 雨猛烈地敲打着广场。

sentences.en: A figure stood under the broken arch, perfectly still.
sentences.cn: 一个身影站在破损的拱门下，一动不动。

sentences.en: I could not see a face, only a dark *shape* against the neon glow — wide shoulders, a long coat, one hand raised toward the camera grid above the gate.

twice:1.en: Ali tapped my shoulder. 'The broadcast came *twice*,' she said, eyes fixed on the cracked screen bolted to the market wall. Most people heard noise. We heard a name — my name — spoken once at full power and once beneath it, buried in static.
twice:1.cnHint: 阿里告诉我，那段广播已经出现了____，其中藏着我的名字。
twice:1.hook: Hearing your name in a coded signal is never an accident.
twice:1.line: 'It played *twice* — whoever sent it knows you are here.'

sentences.en: Ali tapped my shoulder.
sentences.cn: 阿栗拍了拍我的肩膀。

sentences.en: 'The broadcast came *twice*,' she said, eyes fixed on the cracked screen bolted to the market wall.
Most people heard noise.
sentences.cn: 大多数人听到的只是噪音。

sentences.en: We heard a name — my name — spoken once at full power and once beneath it, buried in static.
sentences.cn: 而我们听到了一个名字——我的名字——先是全功率播出一次，然后又埋在静电里低声播出一次。

aspect:1.en: Zero stepped out of the fog. Every *aspect* of his appearance was designed to be forgotten — plain coat, low cap, no colour. But his boots left a pattern in the wet concrete, a small star pressed into each print, and I had seen that mark before.
aspect:1.cnHint: 零点的每个____都刻意平淡，但他靴底的星形印记出卖了他。
aspect:1.hook: He smiled, as if he wanted me to notice.
aspect:1.line: 'Every *aspect* of how I look was chosen — think about why.'

sentences.en: Zero stepped out of the fog.
sentences.cn: 零点从雾中走了出来。

sentences.en: Every *aspect* of his appearance was designed to be forgotten — plain coat, low cap, no colour.
But his boots left a pattern in the wet concrete, a small star pressed into each print, and I had seen that mark before.
sentences.cn: 但他的靴子在湿润的混凝土上留下了图案，每个脚印里都压出了一个小星星，而我以前见过这个标记。

currently:1.en: The market tunnel was dark. Ali held up her scanner. 'Power in this block is *currently* rerouted to the port,' she said, reading the live grid on the small display. That meant the cameras were blind, the locks were open, and someone had planned this outage very carefully.
currently:1.cnHint: 阿里的扫描仪显示，这一街区的电力____被引流到港口方向。
currently:1.hook: Blind cameras mean someone wants no record of tonight.
currently:1.line: 'The whole block is *currently* running on the port feed.'

sentences.en: The market tunnel was dark.
sentences.cn: 市场隧道里一片黑暗。

sentences.en: Ali held up her scanner.
sentences.cn: 阿栗举起了她的扫描仪。

sentences.en: 'Power in this block is *currently* rerouted to the port,' she said, reading the live grid on the small display.
That meant the cameras were blind, the locks were open, and someone had planned this outage very carefully.
sentences.cn: 那意味着摄像头是瞎的，锁是开着的，而且有人非常精心地策划了这次停电。

decrease:1.en: I watched the signal meter on Ali's device. Each minute we stood on the open bridge, the reading would *decrease* by one bar — the encrypted channel was closing, like a door swinging slowly shut. We had maybe four minutes before the frequency was gone for good.
decrease:1.cnHint: 信号强度在____，我们只剩几分钟时间截获那段加密频道。
decrease:1.hook: At zero bars, the only evidence would vanish forever.
decrease:1.line: 'Watch the bars *decrease* — we move now or we lose it.'

sentences.en: I watched the signal meter on Ali's device.
sentences.cn: 我看着阿栗设备上的信号表。

sentences.en: Each minute we stood on the open bridge, the reading would *decrease* by one bar — the encrypted channel was closing, like a door swinging slowly shut.
We had maybe four minutes before the frequency was gone for good.
sentences.cn: 在我们站在开放的桥上的四分钟内，频率就会永久消失。

possibility:1.en: Grey Crow spread a hand-drawn map on the wet hood of a parked vehicle. He traced two routes to the relay tower. 'There is a *possibility* the eastern path is already watched,' he said quietly, finger resting on a narrow alley marked with a small red cross.
possibility:1.cnHint: 灰鸦指着地图，提醒我们东路____已经被人盯上。
possibility:1.hook: The red cross on the map was drawn in fresh ink.
possibility:1.line: 'The *possibility* of a trap on this road is very high.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow spread a hand-drawn map on the wet hood of a parked vehicle.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦在一辆停放车的湿润车盖上铺开了一张手绘地图。

sentences.en: He traced two routes to the relay tower.
sentences.cn: 他画出了两条通往中继塔的路线。

sentences.en: 'There is a *possibility* the eastern path is already watched,' he said quietly, finger resting on a narrow alley marked with a small red cross.

crucial:1.en: The relay box was bolted to the base of the old bridge pillar. Ali knelt in the rain and worked fast. 'This junction is *crucial*,' she said without looking up. 'Cut the wrong wire and the whole signal chain resets — Zero wins and we lose every name on that list.'
crucial:1.cnHint: 阿里说这个接线节点____，剪错一根线，零点的计划就会成功。
crucial:1.hook: Her hand hovered over three wires — red, white, and one with no colour at all.
crucial:1.line: 'This wire is *crucial* — do not let me touch the wrong one.'

sentences.en: The relay box was bolted to the base of the old bridge pillar.
sentences.cn: 中继盒子用螺栓固定在老桥墩的底部。

sentences.en: Ali knelt in the rain and worked fast.
sentences.cn: 阿栗在雨中跪下，动作很快。

sentences.en: 'This junction is *crucial*,' she said without looking up.
'Cut the wrong wire and the whole signal chain resets — Zero wins and we lose every name on that list.'
sentences.cn: 切断错误的电线，整个信号链就会重置——零点赢，我们输，那份名单上的每个人都完了。

responsibility:1.en: The blackout hit Harbor City at midnight. Every screen went dark. Grey Crow pulled me behind a broken wall and said the *responsibility* for keeping the signal alive now fell on us alone. No backup. No orders from above. Just the rain, the dead neon, and the weight of a city counting on two people.
responsibility:1.cnHint: 灰鸦告诉我，维持信号的____现在只落在我们两个人身上。
responsibility:1.hook: Something moved in the dark — it was not Grey Crow.
responsibility:1.line: 'The *responsibility* is yours now. Do not drop it.'

sentences.en: The blackout hit Harbor City at midnight.
sentences.cn: 停电在午夜袭击了港湾城。

sentences.en: Every screen went dark.
sentences.cn: 每块屏幕都黑了。

sentences.en: Grey Crow pulled me behind a broken wall and said the *responsibility* for keeping the signal alive now fell on us alone.
No backup.
sentences.cn: 没有备用。

sentences.en: No orders from above.
sentences.cn: 没有来自上面的命令。

sentences.en: Just the rain, the dead neon, and the weight of a city counting on two people.
sentences.cn: 只有雨、死去的霓虹和一座城市寄托在两个人身上的重量。

soon:1.en: Ali crouched behind the flooded news-stand and checked her wrist scanner. The blackout was spreading block by block, eating the city from the east side inward. '*Soon* the whole grid goes down,' she said, her breath misting in the cold air. I counted the seconds. The last lit sign above us flickered.
soon:1.cnHint: 阿里说，整个电网____就会完全崩溃。
soon:1.hook: The last lit sign above us went out.
soon:1.line: '*Soon* they will find this spot. We must move now.'

sentences.en: Ali crouched behind the flooded news-stand and checked her wrist scanner.
sentences.cn: 阿栗蹲在被淹的新闻摊后面，检查了她的腕部扫描仪。

sentences.en: The blackout was spreading block by block, eating the city from the east side inward. '*Soon* the whole grid goes down,' she said, her breath misting in the cold air.
I counted the seconds.
sentences.cn: 我数着秒钟。

sentences.en: The last lit sign above us flickered.
sentences.cn: 我们上方最后一块亮着的标志闪烁了。

center:1.en: We reached the old broadcast tower at the *center* of Neon Square. Everything in Harbor City once ran through this point — power, data, voice. Now it stood silent, wrapped in fog. The base door was open. Someone had been here before us, and the lock was cut clean.
center:1.cnHint: 我们抵达了霓虹广场的____，那里是全城信号的汇聚之处。
center:1.hook: Inside, a single red light blinked — once, twice, then stopped.
center:1.line: 'The *center* of the grid is right here. Guard it.'

sentences.en: We reached the old broadcast tower at the *center* of Neon Square.
Everything in Harbor City once ran through this point — power, data, voice.
sentences.cn: 港湾城曾经所有的一切都通过这个点运行——电力、数据、语音。

sentences.en: Now it stood silent, wrapped in fog.
sentences.cn: 现在它沉默地矗立着，被雾包裹。

sentences.en: The base door was open.
sentences.cn: 底部的门是开着的。

sentences.en: Someone had been here before us, and the lock was cut clean.
sentences.cn: 有人比我们先到过这里，锁被整齐地切开了。

arrive:1.en: I was watching the east bridge when Zero's signal appeared on my scanner. He would *arrive* in under four minutes. Grey Crow had not answered for twenty. The rain doubled in force. I pulled my collar up and ran toward the alley entrance, hoping the shadows would be enough to hide me.
arrive:1.cnHint: 扫描仪显示，对手零点即将____，而引路人灰鸦仍然失联。
arrive:1.hook: The bridge lights died before Zero ever crossed it.
arrive:1.line: 'When they *arrive*, say nothing. Let me speak first.'

sentences.en: I was watching the east bridge when Zero's signal appeared on my scanner.
sentences.cn: 我在看东桥的时候，零点的信号出现在了我的扫描仪上。

sentences.en: He would *arrive* in under four minutes.
Grey Crow had not answered for twenty.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦已经二十分钟没有回应了。

sentences.en: The rain doubled in force.
sentences.cn: 雨势加倍猛烈。

sentences.en: I pulled my collar up and ran toward the alley entrance, hoping the shadows would be enough to hide me.
sentences.cn: 我拉起衣领跑向小巷入口，希望阴影足以隐藏我。

boost:1.en: Ali jammed a small device into the cracked signal pole on Ink Street. 'This will give us a *boost*,' she said, her fingers moving fast in the rain. The scanner numbers climbed. For the first time all night our broadcast could punch through the blackout wall. Three blocks of dead air came back to life.
boost:1.cnHint: 阿里在路边信号柱上安装装置，为我们的广播提供____。
boost:1.hook: Then the numbers dropped — all the way to zero.
boost:1.line: 'One device, one *boost*. We only get this once.'

sentences.en: Ali jammed a small device into the cracked signal pole on Ink Street.
sentences.cn: 阿栗把一个小装置塞进了墨水街那根裂开的信号杆里。

sentences.en: 'This will give us a *boost*,' she said, her fingers moving fast in the rain.
The scanner numbers climbed.
sentences.cn: 扫描仪的数字往上爬。

sentences.en: For the first time all night our broadcast could punch through the blackout wall.
sentences.cn: 今晚第一次，我们的广播能穿透停电墙了。

sentences.en: Three blocks of dead air came back to life.
sentences.cn: 三个街区的死寂恢复了生机。

conflict:1.en: My orders said to hold the signal channel open. Zero's encrypted message said to shut it down or face the consequences. The two commands *conflicted* in a way I could not ignore. I stood in the wet street, rain running off my jaw, caught between two forces that both claimed to own the truth of this city.
conflict:1.cnHint: 我的指令与零点发来的信息____，让我陷入两难之境。
conflict:1.hook: Grey Crow's voice cut through my earpiece: 'Choose. Right now.'
conflict:1.line: 'Your orders *conflict* with mine. One of us is being used.'

sentences.en: My orders said to hold the signal channel open.
sentences.cn: 我的命令是要保持信号频道开放。

sentences.en: Zero's encrypted message said to shut it down or face the consequences.
sentences.cn: 零点的加密信息说关闭它，否则后果自负。

sentences.en: The two commands *conflicted* in a way I could not ignore.
I stood in the wet street, rain running off my jaw, caught between two forces that both claimed to own the truth of this city.
sentences.cn: 我站在雨中的湿街上，雨水沿着下巴滑下，被两股势力夹在中间，它们都声称拥有这座城市的真相。

demand:1.en: Zero stepped out from under the broken awning. I had not heard him cross the street. He stood close enough that I could see rain on his collar. 'I *demand* the access code,' he said, low and flat, like a door closing. Behind him, two figures waited at the edge of the light.
demand:1.cnHint: 零点拦住了我，____提供通道密码。
demand:1.hook: I reached into my pocket — the code chip was gone.
demand:1.line: 'I *demand* the code. You have until this light dies.'

sentences.en: Zero stepped out from under the broken awning.
sentences.cn: 零点从破损的雨棚下走了出来。

sentences.en: I had not heard him cross the street.
sentences.cn: 我没听到他穿过街道。

sentences.en: He stood close enough that I could see rain on his collar.
sentences.cn: 他站得很近，近到我能看见他领口上的雨珠。

sentences.en: 'I *demand* the access code,' he said, low and flat, like a door closing.
Behind him, two figures waited at the edge of the light.
sentences.cn: 他身后，两个人影在光线边缘等待。

emotion:1.en: Grey Crow never showed *emotion*. I had worked beside him through three operations and he always moved like cold water — steady, quiet, unreadable. So when I saw his hands stop on the scanner and heard one sharp breath escape him, I knew what we had just found in the signal was worse than anything we had planned for.
emotion:1.cnHint: 灰鸦向来不流露____，但这一刻他的反应让我心生不安。
emotion:1.hook: He turned the scanner toward me, and I understood why.
emotion:1.line: 'Keep your *emotion* out of this. Fear is a signal they can read.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow never showed *emotion*.
I had worked beside him through three operations and he always moved like cold water — steady, quiet, unreadable.
sentences.cn: 我在三次行动中和他并肩作战，他总是像冷水一样流动——稳定、安静、难以捉摸。

sentences.en: So when I saw his hands stop on the scanner and heard one sharp breath escape him, I knew what we had just found in the signal was worse than anything we had planned for.
sentences.cn: 所以当我看到他的手停在扫描仪上，听到他吸了一口气时，我就知道我们在信号里发现的东西比我们计划的一切都要糟。

land:1.en: The blackout hit every block from the docks to the old market. Grey Crow pulled me behind a broken wall. 'Look,' he said. A huge map glowed on his cracked screen — neon grids marking every dead zone across the *land*. The silence felt wrong.
land:1.cnHint: 断电之夜，引路人展示了整片____上的失电区域地图。
land:1.hook: Every dead zone matched a name on the stolen list.
land:1.line: 'This *land* has no dark corners I have not mapped.'

sentences.en: The blackout hit every block from the docks to the old market.
sentences.cn: 停电席卷了从码头到老市场的每一个街区。

sentences.en: Grey Crow pulled me behind a broken wall.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦把我拉到了一道破墙后面。

sentences.en: 'Look,' he said.
sentences.cn: "看。"他说。

sentences.en: A huge map glowed on his cracked screen — neon grids marking every dead zone across the *land*.
The silence felt wrong.
sentences.cn: 沉默感觉不对劲。

promote:1.en: Zero's voice cut through the static on every public speaker on the street. 'Harbor City will *promote* a new order tonight,' it said, cold and flat. Ali grabbed my arm. Around us, shop signs flickered and died one by one, as if obeying a command.
promote:1.cnHint: 零点在街头广播中宣称要____一种新秩序，路灯随之熄灭。
promote:1.hook: The last light standing was directly above us.
promote:1.line: 'They *promote* the blackout as progress — do not believe it.'

sentences.en: Zero's voice cut through the static on every public speaker on the street.
sentences.cn: 零点的声音切过了街上每个公共扬声器里的静电噪音。

sentences.en: 'Harbor City will *promote* a new order tonight,' it said, cold and flat.
Ali grabbed my arm.
sentences.cn: 阿栗抓住了我的手臂。

sentences.en: Around us, shop signs flickered and died one by one, as if obeying a command.
sentences.cn: 我们周围，店铺的招牌一个接一个地闪烁熄灭，仿佛在遵从某个命令。

purchase:1.en: Ali had made a small *purchase* at the corner stall before the power died — a cheap signal scanner, barely the size of a coin. Now, in the dark street, it was beeping. Once. Twice. Something nearby was broadcasting on a forbidden channel.
purchase:1.cnHint: 阿栗在停电前的小小____，此刻在黑暗中发出了警报声。
purchase:1.hook: The signal pointed straight toward the sealed metro gate.
purchase:1.line: 'That *purchase* just saved both our lives — run.'

sentences.en: Ali had made a small *purchase* at the corner stall before the power died — a cheap signal scanner, barely the size of a coin.
Now, in the dark street, it was beeping.
sentences.cn: 现在，在黑暗的街道上，它在发出哔哔声。

sentences.en: Once.
sentences.cn: 一下。

sentences.en: Twice.
sentences.cn: 两下。

sentences.en: Something nearby was broadcasting on a forbidden channel.
sentences.cn: 附近有东西在用禁用频道广播。

rely:1.en: The streetlights were gone. My visor cracked during the rush from the docks. Grey Crow was two blocks away. I had nothing. I chose to *rely* on the coded marks Ali had scratched on the walls earlier — small arrows, nearly invisible, pointing the way forward.
rely:1.cnHint: 失去所有设备后，叙述者只能____阿栗提前刻在墙上的暗号箭头。
rely:1.hook: The fourth arrow pointed into a tunnel with no exit sign.
rely:1.line: 'Never *rely* on the grid — it belongs to them now.'

sentences.en: The streetlights were gone.
sentences.cn: 街灯全灭了。

sentences.en: My visor cracked during the rush from the docks.
sentences.cn: 我的护目镜在从码头冲出时裂开了。

sentences.en: Grey Crow was two blocks away.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦在两个街区外。

sentences.en: I had nothing.
sentences.cn: 我什么都没有。

sentences.en: I chose to *rely* on the coded marks Ali had scratched on the walls earlier — small arrows, nearly invisible, pointing the way forward.

connect:1.en: A thin wire ran along the base of the bridge wall. Ali traced it with her flashlight. 'It is meant to *connect* every dark block into one controlled loop,' she said quietly. Grey Crow said nothing. Above us, a drone hummed and slowed, as if listening.
connect:1.cnHint: 阿栗发现一根电线，意图将断电街区____成一个受控回路。
connect:1.hook: The drone's light locked onto the wire — and onto us.
connect:1.line: 'If they *connect* the loop, we lose every safe route.'

sentences.en: A thin wire ran along the base of the bridge wall.
sentences.cn: 一根细铁丝沿着桥墙的底部延伸。

sentences.en: Ali traced it with her flashlight.
sentences.cn: 阿栗用手电筒追踪它。

sentences.en: 'It is meant to *connect* every dark block into one controlled loop,' she said quietly.
Grey Crow said nothing.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦没有说话。

sentences.en: Above us, a drone hummed and slowed, as if listening.
sentences.cn: 我们上方，一架无人机嗡嗡作响，速度变慢了，仿佛在倾听。

indicate:1.en: A thin strip of red light blinked twice on the wall of the old post building. Grey Crow touched my shoulder. 'That signal is meant to *indicate* a live data drop,' he said. Ali was already moving toward it. The rain was getting harder. Time was short.
indicate:1.cnHint: 旧邮政楼墙上的红色信号灯____着一个活跃的数据投递点。
indicate:1.hook: Before Ali reached the wall, the red light went dead.
indicate:1.line: 'Two blinks *indicate* danger — do not touch that panel.'

sentences.en: A thin strip of red light blinked twice on the wall of the old post building.
