sentences.cn: 阿栗在中转枢纽的一条凳子下发现了粘着的数据芯片。

sentences.en: Around us, tired workers grabbed a *rest* between shifts, eyes down, earbuds in.
Nobody looked our way.
sentences.cn: 没人往我们这边看。

sentences.en: That was either good luck or a very careful trap.
sentences.cn: 这要么是好运，要么是精心设下的陷阱。

employer:2.en: The badge on the floor carried a name I did not recognise. I ran it through the city index. The registered *employer* was a logistics firm that had been officially closed for six years. Someone was still using its ghost identity to move people through Harbor City.
employer:2.cnHint: 地上的证件显示，持有者的____是一家六年前已关闭的幽灵公司。
employer:2.hook: Closed firms do not hire guards — but this one had dozens.
employer:2.line: 'Your *employer* does not exist,' I said, 'so who signs your pay?'

sentences.en: The badge on the floor carried a name I did not recognise.
sentences.cn: 地上的证件上写着我不认识的名字。

sentences.en: I ran it through the city index.
sentences.cn: 我在城市档案里查了一下。

sentences.en: The registered *employer* was a logistics firm that had been officially closed for six years.
Someone was still using its ghost identity to move people through Harbor City.
sentences.cn: 有人还在用这个已注销六年的物流公司的幽灵身份在港城运送人员。

owner:2.en: The storage locker had no number, only a scratch mark shaped like a crow. Inside: one envelope, one key. The *owner* of this locker had left in a hurry — a cold cup of tea still sat on the shelf beside the door, barely touched.
owner:2.cnHint: 储物柜里有人匆忙留下的信封和钥匙，这个柜子的____已经消失了。
owner:2.hook: The key had teeth I had never seen on any lock in this city.
owner:2.line: 'The *owner* left this for you,' Zero said, voice flat as a blade.

sentences.en: The storage locker had no number, only a scratch mark shaped like a crow.
sentences.cn: 储物柜上没有号码，只有一道乌鸦形的刮痕。

sentences.en: Inside: one envelope, one key.
sentences.cn: 里面：一个信封，一把钥匙。

sentences.en: The *owner* of this locker had left in a hurry — a cold cup of tea still sat on the shelf beside the door, barely touched.

gender:2.en: The coded profile listed age, district, and skill set — but the field for *gender* was filled with a single dash. Grey Crow said that was a known signature: operatives trained by the Null Syndicate scrubbed that field first, before anything else.
gender:2.cnHint: 档案里____一栏只有一个破折号，这是某个神秘组织的惯用手法。
gender:2.hook: Every Null Syndicate operative we had ever found was already dead.
gender:2.line: 'They erase *gender* first,' Grey Crow said, 'then they erase everything else.'

sentences.en: The coded profile listed age, district, and skill set — but the field for *gender* was filled with a single dash.
Grey Crow said that was a known signature: operatives trained by the Null Syndicate scrubbed that field first, before anything else.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦说这是个标志性特征——零点集团培训的特务会最先抹掉这一栏，什么都不留。

website:2.en: Zero sent a single link. The *website* loaded as a plain white page — no images, no menu, just a text box and a countdown timer at twelve minutes. I typed nothing. At eleven minutes the box filled itself with my full name and my home address.
website:2.cnHint: 零点发来一个链接，那个____上的文本框自动填入了我的真实姓名和住址。
website:2.hook: Eleven minutes left, and I still did not know what it was counting down to.
website:2.line: 'Delete that *website* history now,' Ali said, grabbing my arm.

sentences.en: Zero sent a single link.
sentences.cn: 零点发来一条链接。

sentences.en: The *website* loaded as a plain white page — no images, no menu, just a text box and a countdown timer at twelve minutes.
I typed nothing.
sentences.cn: 我没有输入任何东西。

sentences.en: At eleven minutes the box filled itself with my full name and my home address.
sentences.cn: 十一分钟时，方框里自动填满了我的全名和家庭住址。

emotional:2.en: The voice recording on the chip was short — thirty seconds. The speaker kept their tone flat, almost mechanical, as if reading from a list. But at the last word it cracked. That single *emotional* break told me more than the whole message: whoever sent this was afraid.
emotional:2.cnHint: 录音里说话者始终保持冷静，但最后一个词里那一丝____的颤抖出卖了他们。
emotional:2.hook: Afraid people make mistakes — and this one had made exactly one.
emotional:2.line: 'That *emotional* slip at the end — play it again,' Grey Crow said quietly.

sentences.en: The voice recording on the chip was short — thirty seconds.
sentences.cn: 芯片里的语音录音很短——三十秒。

sentences.en: The speaker kept their tone flat, almost mechanical, as if reading from a list.
sentences.cn: 说话者的语调始终很平静，几乎是机械的，像在念一份清单。

sentences.en: But at the last word it cracked.
sentences.cn: 但说到最后一个词时，声音裂了。

sentences.en: That single *emotional* break told me more than the whole message: whoever sent this was afraid.

training:2.en: The manual was old, printed on real paper — rare in 2099. Chapter one covered signal interception. The margins were full of handwritten notes. The style matched Grey Crow's exactly. This was not a manual for rookies. This was the *training* guide used by the unit that disappeared in 2091.
training:2.cnHint: 这本纸质手册是2091年失踪小队所用的____资料，页边布满了灰鸦的笔迹。
training:2.hook: Grey Crow had told me that unit never existed.
training:2.line: 'This *training* material was supposed to be destroyed,' Grey Crow said, pale.

sentences.en: The manual was old, printed on real paper — rare in 2099.
sentences.cn: 手册很旧，印在真纸张上——2099年这种东西很罕见。

sentences.en: Chapter one covered signal interception.
sentences.cn: 第一章讲的是信号截获。

sentences.en: The margins were full of handwritten notes.
sentences.cn: 页边空白处全是手写笔记。

sentences.en: The style matched Grey Crow's exactly.
sentences.cn: 笔迹和灰鸦的一模一样。

sentences.en: This was not a manual for rookies.
sentences.cn: 这不是给新手看的手册。

sentences.en: This was the *training* guide used by the unit that disappeared in 2091.

responsibility:2.en: The blackout hit at midnight. Every screen in Harbor City went dark. Grey Crow pressed a cold data chip into my hand. 'This holds the names of everyone who knew,' he said. The *responsibility* of carrying it — of keeping it safe — landed on me like a stone.
responsibility:2.cnHint: 断电后，灰鸦将一块数据芯片交给我，告诉我这是我必须承担的____。
responsibility:2.hook: Someone already knew I had it.
responsibility:2.line: 'This is your *responsibility* now — do not lose it.'

sentences.en: The blackout hit at midnight.
sentences.cn: 停电发生在午夜。

sentences.en: Every screen in Harbor City went dark.
sentences.cn: 港湾城的每块屏幕都黑了。

sentences.en: Grey Crow pressed a cold data chip into my hand.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦把一枚冷冰冰的数据芯片塞进我手里。

sentences.en: 'This holds the names of everyone who knew,' he said.
sentences.cn: "这里面装着所有知情者的名字，"他说。

sentences.en: The *responsibility* of carrying it — of keeping it safe — landed on me like a stone.

soon:2.en: Ali found the message scratched into the wall of Sub-level Nine — three words, no signature. She photographed it fast and pulled me toward the exit. 'They wrote this *soon* before the power died,' she said, eyes sharp. The ink was still faintly warm under my fingers.
soon:2.cnHint: 阿栗在断电前不久发现了墙上刻下的神秘信息，并迅速拍照。
soon:2.hook: The writer might still be watching from the dark.
soon:2.line: 'They left this *soon* before the lights went out.'

sentences.en: Ali found the message scratched into the wall of Sub-level Nine — three words, no signature.
sentences.cn: 阿栗在九层地下室的墙上发现了这条信息——刮得很深，三个单词，没有署名。

sentences.en: She photographed it fast and pulled me toward the exit.
sentences.cn: 她快速拍下照片，拉着我朝出口跑。

sentences.en: 'They wrote this *soon* before the power died,' she said, eyes sharp.
The ink was still faintly warm under my fingers.
sentences.cn: 纸张在我指尖还残留着淡淡的温度。

center:2.en: The dead signal led us to an abandoned relay tower at the *center* of the old port district. Rain hammered the metal roof. Inside, a single chair faced a blank monitor. Someone had been living here — working here. A half-eaten ration pack sat beside a stack of encrypted discs.
center:2.cnHint: 信号引导我们来到旧港区正____处的一座废弃信号塔。
center:2.hook: The monitor flickered once, then showed my face.
center:2.line: 'Everything points back to the *center* of the old port.'

sentences.en: The dead signal led us to an abandoned relay tower at the *center* of the old port district.
Rain hammered the metal roof.
sentences.cn: 雨猛烈地敲打着金属屋顶。

sentences.en: Inside, a single chair faced a blank monitor.
sentences.cn: 里面，一把孤零零的椅子对着一块黑屏。

sentences.en: Someone had been living here — working here.
sentences.cn: 有人在这里生活过——工作过。

sentences.en: A half-eaten ration pack sat beside a stack of encrypted discs.
sentences.cn: 半吃完的口粮包就放在一堆加密光盘旁边。

arrive:2.en: We had forty minutes before the backup grid came online. Grey Crow said the courier would *arrive* at the east platform with the decryption key. Ali and I crouched behind a stack of cargo containers, watching the dark tunnel. The clock on my wrist counted down in silence.
arrive:2.cnHint: 我们在东站台等待信使____，以拿到解密密钥。
arrive:2.hook: The figure that stepped out was not the courier.
arrive:2.line: 'The courier will *arrive* before the grid comes back online.'

sentences.en: We had forty minutes before the backup grid came online.
sentences.cn: 备用电网上线还有四十分钟。

sentences.en: Grey Crow said the courier would *arrive* at the east platform with the decryption key.
Ali and I crouched behind a stack of cargo containers, watching the dark tunnel.
sentences.cn: 阿栗和我蹲在一堆货柜后面，盯着黑漆漆的隧道。

sentences.en: The clock on my wrist counted down in silence.
sentences.cn: 我手腕上的时钟无声地倒计时。

boost:2.en: The signal was too weak to read. Ali pulled a small device from her coat — a homemade amplifier — and clipped it to the receiver. The static cleared in seconds. 'That should *boost* it enough,' she said quietly. The message that came through made my breath stop cold.
boost:2.cnHint: 阿栗用自制放大器来____信号强度，解码出一条令人震惊的信息。
boost:2.hook: The message contained only one word: run.
boost:2.line: 'This will *boost* the signal enough to read it.'

sentences.en: The signal was too weak to read.
sentences.cn: 信号太弱，读不出来。

sentences.en: Ali pulled a small device from her coat — a homemade amplifier — and clipped it to the receiver.
sentences.cn: 阿栗从外套里掏出一个小设备——自制的放大器——夹到接收器上。

sentences.en: The static cleared in seconds.
sentences.cn: 静电噪音在几秒内消了。

sentences.en: 'That should *boost* it enough,' she said quietly.
The message that came through made my breath stop cold.
sentences.cn: 传过来的信息让我屏住了呼吸。

conflict:2.en: Grey Crow wanted to destroy the disc. I said no. Our views began to *conflict* the moment I read what was on it — names of city officials, hidden payments, a cover-up reaching back ten years. He stared at me across the damp corridor. Neither of us moved.
conflict:2.cnHint: 关于如何处理这张光盘，我与灰鸦的意见开始____。
conflict:2.hook: One of us would have to walk away empty-handed.
conflict:2.line: 'Our plans *conflict* — only one of us is right.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow wanted to destroy the disc.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦想销毁那张光盘。

sentences.en: I said no.
sentences.cn: 我说不行。

sentences.en: Our views began to *conflict* the moment I read what was on it — names of city officials, hidden payments, a cover-up reaching back ten years.
He stared at me across the damp corridor.
sentences.cn: 他在潮湿的走廊里盯着我。

sentences.en: Neither of us moved.
sentences.cn: 我们都没有动。

demand:2.en: The locked terminal blinked a single prompt: access code. Zero's voice came through the speaker, low and flat. 'I *demand* the sequence you took from Sub-level Nine,' he said. 'Give it now, or the whole grid stays dark.' My fingers hovered over the keypad. Ali shook her head slowly.
demand:2.cnHint: 零点通过终端____我交出从九层取走的密码序列。
demand:2.hook: I typed the first digit, then stopped.
demand:2.line: 'I *demand* the sequence — give it to me now.'

sentences.en: The locked terminal blinked a single prompt: access code.
sentences.cn: 锁定的终端闪烁着一个提示：输入密码。

sentences.en: Zero's voice came through the speaker, low and flat.
sentences.cn: 零点的声音从扬声器里传出来，低沉而冷漠。

sentences.en: 'I *demand* the sequence you took from Sub-level Nine,' he said.
'Give it now, or the whole grid stays dark.'
sentences.cn: "现在把你从九层地下室拿到的序列交出来，"他说。

sentences.en: My fingers hovered over the keypad.
sentences.cn: 我的手指在数字键盘上悬停着。

sentences.en: Ali shook her head slowly.
sentences.cn: 阿栗缓缓摇了摇头。

emotion:2.en: The final log file was just a voice recording — a technician speaking alone in the dark. There was no *emotion* in her voice, only flat, careful words describing what she had found buried in the city's core systems. That calm made it worse. Facts delivered without feeling hit hardest.
emotion:2.cnHint: 日志录音里，那位技术员毫无____地陈述着她在系统深处发现的秘密。
emotion:2.hook: She ended the recording with three seconds of silence.
emotion:2.line: 'There is no *emotion* in her voice — that is what scares me.'

sentences.en: The final log file was just a voice recording — a technician speaking alone in the dark.
sentences.cn: 最后一份日志文件只是一段语音录音——一个技术员在黑暗里独自说话。

sentences.en: There was no *emotion* in her voice, only flat, careful words describing what she had found buried in the city's core systems.
That calm made it worse.
sentences.cn: 那种平静让事情变得更糟。

sentences.en: Facts delivered without feeling hit hardest.
sentences.cn: 没有感情的事实最能击中人心。

consume:2.en: The blackout hit at 03:00. I found the server room unlocked, its cooling fans dead. A single rogue process was running — something designed to *consume* every spare cycle on the city grid, draining power block by block. Ali spotted the source node. We had seconds before Harbor City went completely dark.
consume:2.cnHint: 停电之夜，我们发现一个程序正在____整个城市电网的算力资源。
consume:2.hook: The source node blinked once, then vanished from the map.
consume:2.line: 'It will *consume* the whole grid before dawn,' Ali said, fingers flying.

sentences.en: The blackout hit at 03:00.
sentences.cn: 停电发生在凌晨三点。

sentences.en: I found the server room unlocked, its cooling fans dead.
sentences.cn: 我发现服务器室的门没上锁，冷却风扇已经停转。

sentences.en: A single rogue process was running — something designed to *consume* every spare cycle on the city grid, draining power block by block.
Ali spotted the source node.
sentences.cn: 阿栗发现了信号源。

sentences.en: We had seconds before Harbor City went completely dark.
sentences.cn: 我们只有几秒钟的时间，否则港城就要完全陷入黑暗。

desire:2.en: Grey Crow slid a data chip across the wet table. 'Zero does not act for money,' he said quietly. 'Zero acts on *desire* — a deep need to watch systems fall.' I turned the chip over in my fingers. Outside, a transformer blew. The lights on Dock Nine died one by one.
desire:2.cnHint: 灰鸦提醒我，零点的动机不是金钱，而是内心深处的____。
desire:2.hook: The chip was warm, as if someone had been holding it until just now.
desire:2.line: '*Desire* is the only code Zero never bothers to hide,' Grey Crow said.

sentences.en: Grey Crow slid a data chip across the wet table.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦把一块数据芯片滑过湿漉漉的桌子。

sentences.en: 'Zero does not act for money,' he said quietly.
sentences.cn: "零点不为钱而行动，"他轻声说。

sentences.en: 'Zero acts on *desire* — a deep need to watch systems fall.'
I turned the chip over in my fingers.
sentences.cn: 我在指尖翻转着芯片。

sentences.en: Outside, a transformer blew.
sentences.cn: 外面，一台变压器爆炸了。

sentences.en: The lights on Dock Nine died one by one.
sentences.cn: 九号码头的灯一盏接一盏地熄灭了。

meal:2.en: Ali and I sheltered in a noodle stall under the overpass while the blackout spread. The owner slid us two bowls without a word — our first *meal* in eighteen hours. I ate fast, eyes on the dark skyline. Between the towers, a green signal light blinked in a pattern I almost recognised.
meal:2.cnHint: 停电蔓延时，我和阿栗在天桥下的小摊吃了失踪已久的____。
meal:2.hook: That blinking pattern — it was not random traffic; it was a message.
meal:2.line: 'Eat. A cold *meal* is still better than a dead lead,' Ali said.

sentences.en: Ali and I sheltered in a noodle stall under the overpass while the blackout spread.
sentences.cn: 阿栗和我在高架桥下的面馆里躲避，停电不断蔓延。

sentences.en: The owner slid us two bowls without a word — our first *meal* in eighteen hours.
I ate fast, eyes on the dark skyline.
sentences.cn: 我狼吞虎咽地吃着，眼睛盯着漆黑的天际线。

sentences.en: Between the towers, a green signal light blinked in a pattern I almost recognised.
sentences.cn: 高楼之间，一盏绿色的信号灯闪烁着，节奏几乎被我认了出来。

vegetable:2.en: The coded graffiti was painted on the wall of an old *vegetable* market, shut since the city banned street vendors in 2091. Among the faded price signs, three characters were fresh — bright orange, still wet. I photographed them. Ali ran the cipher. The result was a set of coordinates deep in the port district.
vegetable:2.cnHint: 我在一处废弃的____市场的墙上发现了刚刚涂上的密语。
vegetable:2.hook: The coordinates pointed to a building that officially did not exist.
vegetable:2.line: 'Meet me at the *vegetable* market. Come alone,' the spray-painted note read.

sentences.en: The coded graffiti was painted on the wall of an old *vegetable* market, shut since the city banned street vendors in 2091.
Among the faded price signs, three characters were fresh — bright orange, still wet.
sentences.cn: 在褪色的价格标签中间，三个字刚刚被画上去——亮橙色，还在滴水。

sentences.en: I photographed them.
sentences.cn: 我拍了张照。

sentences.en: Ali ran the cipher.
sentences.cn: 阿栗破解了密码。

sentences.en: The result was a set of coordinates deep in the port district.
sentences.cn: 结果是港口地区深处的一组坐标。

adopt:2.en: Grey Crow told me Zero used to work for the city. Then Zero chose to *adopt* a different method — not reform, not protest, but total erasure. Every system Zero touched was left empty, like a mind wiped clean. I stared at the blank terminal screen and felt a chill that had nothing to do with the rain.
adopt:2.cnHint: 灰鸦解释说，零点决定____一种极端的方式来对抗这座城市。
adopt:2.hook: Empty systems, Grey Crow whispered, are easier to rewrite from scratch.
adopt:2.line: 'Zero did not rebel — Zero chose to *adopt* silence as a weapon,' Grey Crow said.

sentences.en: Grey Crow told me Zero used to work for the city.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦告诉我零点曾经为这座城市工作。

sentences.en: Then Zero chose to *adopt* a different method — not reform, not protest, but total erasure.
Every system Zero touched was left empty, like a mind wiped clean.
sentences.cn: 零点接触过的每一个系统都被清空了，就像一个被彻底擦拭的大脑。

sentences.en: I stared at the blank terminal screen and felt a chill that had nothing to do with the rain.
sentences.cn: 我盯着空白的终端屏幕，感到一阵寒意，那不仅仅是因为雨。

miss:2.en: The relay tower on Pier Four was supposed to be offline. It was not. I climbed to the access panel and found a small receiver taped inside — easy to *miss* unless you knew what you were looking for. A red light pulsed on it every four seconds. Someone was already listening on this frequency.
miss:2.cnHint: 我在码头的中继塔里发现了一个极易____的隐藏接收器。
miss:2.hook: Four seconds between pulses — the same interval as a human heartbeat.
miss:2.line: 'Most inspectors *miss* it. You did not. That worries me,' Grey Crow said.

sentences.en: The relay tower on Pier Four was supposed to be offline.
sentences.cn: 四号码头的中继塔本应离线。

sentences.en: It was not.
sentences.cn: 但它没有。

sentences.en: I climbed to the access panel and found a small receiver taped inside — easy to *miss* unless you knew what you were looking for.
A red light pulsed on it every four seconds.
sentences.cn: 一盏红灯每四秒闪烁一次。

sentences.en: Someone was already listening on this frequency.
sentences.cn: 已经有人在这个频率上监听了。

yourself:2.en: A voice came through the dead comm channel — calm, almost kind. 'You are deeper in than you know,' it said. 'Ask *yourself* how you found this frequency. Ask yourself who left the door open.' I had no answer. The channel closed with a single tone, and the rain outside grew louder.
yourself:2.cnHint: 神秘声音让我好好问问____，为何每一步都走得如此顺利。
yourself:2.hook: Every door I had opened tonight — had someone else unlocked it first?
yourself:2.line: 'Ask *yourself* why nothing tonight has actually stopped you,' the voice said.

sentences.en: A voice came through the dead comm channel — calm, almost kind.
sentences.cn: 一个声音从死寂的通讯频道传来——冷静，几乎温和。

sentences.en: 'You are deeper in than you know,' it said.
sentences.cn: "你陷得比你想象的要深，"它说。

sentences.en: 'Ask *yourself* how you found this frequency.
Ask yourself who left the door open.'
sentences.cn: 问问你自己谁留下的门。

sentences.en: I had no answer.
sentences.cn: 我没有答案。

sentences.en: The channel closed with a single tone, and the rain outside grew louder.
sentences.cn: 频道以一声单调的嘟声关闭，外面的雨声变得更大了。

century:2.en: The archive terminal still ran on hardware from the last *century* — dusty, slow, nearly forgotten. But it was not connected to the main grid, which meant it survived the blackout intact. I searched for Zero's early records. One file remained, partially corrupted. The name on it matched no face I had ever seen.
century:2.cnHint: 我在一台上____遗留的老旧终端上找到了关于零点的残缺档案。
century:2.hook: The name in the file belonged to someone the city claimed had never existed.
century:2.line: 'This machine is a *century* old — and it still knows more than we do,' Ali said.

sentences.en: The archive terminal still ran on hardware from the last *century* — dusty, slow, nearly forgotten.
But it was not connected to the main grid, which meant it survived the blackout intact.
sentences.cn: 但它没有连接到主电网，这意味着它在停电中活了下来。

sentences.en: I searched for Zero's early records.
sentences.cn: 我搜索零点的早期记录。

sentences.en: One file remained, partially corrupted.
sentences.cn: 只剩下一个文件，部分已损坏。

sentences.en: The name on it matched no face I had ever seen.
sentences.cn: 上面的名字与我见过的任何脸都不匹配。

management:2.en: The server room was cold and dark after the blackout. I found a printed memo on the floor: *management* had ordered all language-filter logs deleted by midnight. Someone powerful wanted those records gone. Ali pressed close behind me, breath held. Outside, rain hammered the steel walls.
management:2.cnHint: 我在服务器室发现一份备忘录，显示____下令销毁所有语言过滤日志。
management:2.hook: The deletion timer on the screen read: four minutes left.
management:2.line: '*Management* signed this order — but the signature is fake.'

sentences.en: The server room was cold and dark after the blackout.
sentences.cn: 停电后的服务器室又冷又黑。

sentences.en: I found a printed memo on the floor: *management* had ordered all language-filter logs deleted by midnight.
Someone powerful wanted those records gone.
sentences.cn: 有人想让这些记录消失。

sentences.en: Ali pressed close behind me, breath held.
sentences.cn: 阿栗紧紧贴在我身后，屏住呼吸。

sentences.en: Outside, rain hammered the steel walls.
sentences.cn: 外面，雨敲打着钢制的墙壁。

perfect:2.en: Grey Crow slid a data chip across the wet bench. 'This is a *perfect* copy of Zero's broadcast key,' he said quietly. I turned it over in my fingers. Every edge was clean, every code line intact. Too clean. In Harbor City, nothing arrived this easily without a price attached.
perfect:2.cnHint: 引路人交给我一份____的密钥副本，但我感到事情没那么简单。
perfect:2.hook: Grey Crow's eyes never once met mine.
perfect:2.line: 'A *perfect* copy — which means someone wanted us to find it.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow slid a data chip across the wet bench.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦把一块数据芯片滑过湿漉漉的长椅。

sentences.en: 'This is a *perfect* copy of Zero's broadcast key,' he said quietly.
I turned it over in my fingers.
sentences.cn: 我在指尖翻转着它。

sentences.en: Every edge was clean, every code line intact.
sentences.cn: 每条边都很干净，每一行代码都完好无损。

sentences.en: Too clean.
sentences.cn: 太干净了。

sentences.en: In Harbor City, nothing arrived this easily without a price attached.
sentences.cn: 在港城，没有什么东西能这么容易到手而不付出代价。

along:2.en: I moved *along* the narrow catwalk above the city's main relay station, flashlight off, counting steps in the dark. Below, Zero's signal pulsed in short, sharp bursts. Ali had mapped this route, but one section of the floor was missing entirely. The gap yawned three metres wide.
along:2.cnHint: 我____狭窄的走道前行，发现零点的信号就在脚下跳动。
along:2.hook: My next step landed on nothing but air.
along:2.line: 'Come *along* — the signal is strongest at the far end.'

sentences.en: I moved *along* the narrow catwalk above the city's main relay station, flashlight off, counting steps in the dark.
Below, Zero's signal pulsed in short, sharp bursts.
sentences.cn: 下面，零点的信号以短而尖锐的脉冲闪烁。

sentences.en: Ali had mapped this route, but one section of the floor was missing entirely.
sentences.cn: 阿栗已经规划了这条路线，但有一段地板完全断裂了。

sentences.en: The gap yawned three metres wide.
sentences.cn: 缝隙足有三米宽。

harm:2.en: The graffiti on the substation wall read: WORDS CAN *HARM*. Underneath, someone had carved a frequency number into the brick. I photographed it fast. The same phrase had appeared at every blackout site this week. It was not a warning to citizens — it was a message to someone who understood the code.
harm:2.cnHint: 变电站墙上的涂鸦写着"文字能____"，下面藏着一个神秘频率。
harm:2.hook: My scanner picked up a live signal on that exact frequency.
harm:2.line: 'Words *harm* more than weapons in this city — remember that.'

sentences.en: The graffiti on the substation wall read: WORDS CAN *HARM*.
Underneath, someone had carved a frequency number into the brick.
sentences.cn: 下面，有人在砖头上刻了一个频率数字。

sentences.en: I photographed it fast.
sentences.cn: 我快速拍了张照。

sentences.en: The same phrase had appeared at every blackout site this week.
sentences.cn: 这个短语在这周的每一处停电地点都出现过。

sentences.en: It was not a warning to citizens — it was a message to someone who understood the code.
sentences.cn: 这不是对市民的警告——这是对懂代码的人的信息。

increasingly:2.en: The power cuts were *increasingly* frequent: three this week, five the week before. I spread the incident maps across the table in the safe flat. Each blackout followed a coded radio burst by exactly ninety seconds. Ali circled the pattern in red. It was not random failure. It was a rehearsal.
increasingly:2.cnHint: 停电事件____频繁，我和阿栗发现每次停电前都有一段加密广播。
increasingly:2.line: 'The gaps are *increasingly* short — the next hit is tonight.'

sentences.en: The power cuts were *increasingly* frequent: three this week, five the week before.
I spread the incident maps across the table in the safe flat.
sentences.cn: 我把事件地图铺开在安全屋的桌子上。

sentences.en: Each blackout followed a coded radio burst by exactly ninety seconds.
sentences.cn: 每次停电都在编码电台信号之后恰好九十秒出现。

sentences.en: Ali circled the pattern in red.
sentences.cn: 阿栗用红笔圈出了这个规律。

sentences.en: It was not random failure.
sentences.cn: 这不是随机故障。

sentences.en: It was a rehearsal.
sentences.cn: 这是一场排练。

opinion:2.en: 'In my *opinion*,' Ali said, holding up the recovered hard drive, 'this was planted.' I looked at the clean casing — no dust, no scratches, though the shelf around it was thick with grime. Someone had placed it here recently. Grey Crow had told us to search this room. Grey Crow alone.
opinion:2.cnHint: 阿栗认为这块硬盘是被人故意放置的，我开始怀疑引路人的动机。
opinion:2.hook: The drive's only file was addressed to my name.
opinion:2.line: 'My *opinion* is that Grey Crow led us straight into a trap.'

sentences.en: 'In my *opinion*,' Ali said, holding up the recovered hard drive, 'this was planted.'
I looked at the clean casing — no dust, no scratches, though the shelf around it was thick with grime.
sentences.cn: 我看着那个干净的壳体——没有灰尘，没有划痕，尽管它周围的架子上厚厚一层灰。

sentences.en: Someone had placed it here recently.
sentences.cn: 有人最近把它放在这里。

sentences.en: Grey Crow had told us to search this room.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦让我们搜索这个房间。

sentences.en: Grey Crow alone.
sentences.cn: 只有灰鸦。

previous:2.en: The access log showed my *previous* visit to this floor — except I had never been here before. Someone had cloned my ID tag and used it three nights ago, the same night the city's language-filter core went dark. I stared at my own name on the screen. My hands went cold.
previous:2.cnHint: 门禁记录显示我____曾来过这里，但那根本不可能是我。
previous:2.hook: The clone had left something behind in locker seven.
previous:2.line: 'Your *previous* visit triggered the deletion — you were set up.'

sentences.en: The access log showed my *previous* visit to this floor — except I had never been here before.
Someone had cloned my ID tag and used it three nights ago, the same night the city's language-filter core went dark.
sentences.cn: 有人克隆了我的门卡，三天前用过——就在城市语言过滤核心熄灭的那晚。

sentences.en: I stared at my own name on the screen.
sentences.cn: 我盯着屏幕上自己的名字。

sentences.en: My hands went cold.
sentences.cn: 我的手冰冷了下来。

aim:2.en: Zero's broadcast carried a single sentence repeated on loop: 'The *aim* is the archive.' I wrote it down and stared. The city's forbidden-word archive held every banned signal ever recorded — proof of who gave the censorship orders. If Zero reached it first, those names would vanish forever.
aim:2.cnHint: 零点的广播透露出他的____是那座存有禁用词汇的秘密档案库。
aim:2.hook: The archive's location had just appeared on my scanner.
aim:2.line: 'Our *aim* must be to reach that archive before Zero does.'

sentences.en: Zero's broadcast carried a single sentence repeated on loop: 'The *aim* is the archive.'
I wrote it down and stared.
sentences.cn: 我把它写下来，盯着看。

sentences.en: The city's forbidden-word archive held every banned signal ever recorded — proof of who gave the censorship orders.
sentences.cn: 城市的禁词档案里存了所有被记录过的禁播信号——这是谁下达审查令的证据。

sentences.en: If Zero reached it first, those names would vanish forever.
sentences.cn: 如果零点先到了，那些名字会永远消失。

model:2.en: Inside the flooded archive room, Grey Crow pulled a small wire *model* of Harbor City from a sealed case. Every tower, every tunnel — built with impossible detail. 'This is not art,' he said. 'This is a map of something that hasn't been built yet.' Outside, the rain hammered harder.
model:2.cnHint: 灰鸦在档案室发现了一个Harbor City的线框____，细节精确得令人不安。
model:2.hook: The unbuilt district on the model matched tomorrow's blackout zone.
model:2.line: 'This *model* was made by someone who knew the future.'

sentences.en: Inside the flooded archive room, Grey Crow pulled a small wire *model* of Harbor City from a sealed case.
Every tower, every tunnel — built with impossible detail.
sentences.cn: 每座塔楼，每条隧道——细节精美得不可能。

sentences.en: 'This is not art,' he said.
sentences.cn: 这不是艺术，他说。

sentences.en: 'This is a map of something that hasn't been built yet.'
sentences.cn: 这是一张还没被建造出来的东西的地图。

sentences.en: Outside, the rain hammered harder.
sentences.cn: 外面，雨下得更急了。

spot:2.en: Ali crouched behind a dead server rack, scanning the dark corridor. Then she went still. Three guards, no flashlights — but she could *spot* the faint blue glow of their visors in the black. She counted heartbeats. One. Two. She pressed the small transmitter into my hand without a word.
spot:2.cnHint: 阿栗在黑暗走廊中____了戴着发光护目镜的守卫，悄悄将装置递给了我。
spot:2.hook: A fourth visor blinked on — right behind us.
spot:2.line: 'I can *spot* them even when they kill the lights.'

sentences.en: Ali crouched behind a dead server rack, scanning the dark corridor.
sentences.cn: 阿栗蹲在一个报废的服务器机架后面，扫描着黑暗的走廊。

sentences.en: Then she went still.
sentences.cn: 然后她停住了。

sentences.en: Three guards, no flashlights — but she could *spot* the faint blue glow of their visors in the black.
She counted heartbeats.
sentences.cn: 她数着心跳。

sentences.en: One.
sentences.cn: 一。

sentences.en: Two.
sentences.cn: 二。

sentences.en: She pressed the small transmitter into my hand without a word.
sentences.cn: 她把小发射器塞进我手里，什么话都没说。

achievement:2.en: The wall was covered in coded graffiti, but one line stood apart: a list of dates and a single word — *achievement*. Grey Crow traced it with one finger. 'Each date is a blackout,' he said quietly. 'Someone is keeping score.' I photographed every line before the patrol light swept the alley.
achievement:2.cnHint: 涂鸦墙上用暗语记录着每次断电，灰鸦称之为某人的____。
achievement:2.hook: The final date on the list was tonight.
achievement:2.line: 'Every blackout on this wall is Zero's *achievement*.'

sentences.en: The wall was covered in coded graffiti, but one line stood apart: a list of dates and a single word — *achievement*.
Grey Crow traced it with one finger.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦用一根手指描过那条线。

sentences.en: 'Each date is a blackout,' he said quietly.
sentences.cn: 每一个日期都是一次停电，他轻声说。

sentences.en: 'Someone is keeping score.'
sentences.cn: 有人在记录得分。

sentences.en: I photographed every line before the patrol light swept the alley.
sentences.cn: 巡逻灯扫过小巷之前，我拍下了每一行字。

enter:2.en: The side door had no handle, no keypad — just a narrow slot at chest height. Ali slid a thin card through it. A soft click. 'Your turn,' she whispered. I had to *enter* sideways, shoulders scraping cold metal, breath held. The room beyond smelled of burnt circuits and old paper.
enter:2.cnHint: 我们通过一道隐秘的侧门____了那个气味异常的房间。
enter:2.hook: Something inside the room was still warm.
enter:2.line: 'Once you *enter*, there is no quiet way back out.'

sentences.en: The side door had no handle, no keypad — just a narrow slot at chest height.
sentences.cn: 侧门没有把手，没有键盘——只在胸口高度有一条窄槽。

sentences.en: Ali slid a thin card through it.
sentences.cn: 阿栗从里面滑过一张薄卡。

sentences.en: A soft click.
sentences.cn: 轻微的咔哒声。

sentences.en: 'Your turn,' she whispered.
sentences.cn: 该你了，她低声说。

sentences.en: I had to *enter* sideways, shoulders scraping cold metal, breath held.
The room beyond smelled of burnt circuits and old paper.
sentences.cn: 房间里闻起来像烧焦的电路和陈旧的纸张。

eye:2.en: Zero's broadcast cut into every screen on Level Nine. No face — only a single, unblinking *eye* drawn in white pixels on black. Below it, four words scrolled in silence: YOU ARE TOO LATE. Ali grabbed my sleeve. The screens died one by one, floor by floor, climbing toward us.
eye:2.cnHint: 零点的广播画面中只有一只____，随后整层楼的屏幕开始逐一熄灭。
eye:2.hook: The last screen to die was the one in our room.
eye:2.line: 'That *eye* means Zero already knows where we are.'

sentences.en: Zero's broadcast cut into every screen on Level Nine.
sentences.cn: 零点的广播切入九楼的每一块屏幕。

sentences.en: No face — only a single, unblinking *eye* drawn in white pixels on black.
Below it, four words scrolled in silence: YOU ARE TOO LATE.
sentences.cn: 下面四个字无声地滚动：你太晚了。

sentences.en: Ali grabbed my sleeve.
sentences.cn: 阿栗抓住我的袖子。

sentences.en: The screens died one by one, floor by floor, climbing toward us.
sentences.cn: 屏幕一个接一个死去，楼层一层层向上爬，朝我们靠近。

shift:2.en: At 02:00 the power grid made its nightly *shift* — backup lines taking over, one sector at a time. Grey Crow had memorized the pattern. 'We have eleven seconds of full dark between sectors,' he said, pulling up the timing chart. 'That is our door.' I set my watch. Eleven seconds felt very short.
shift:2.cnHint: 灰鸦利用电网每晚的____规律，找到了行动的窗口期。
shift:2.hook: Tonight, the shift came four seconds early.
shift:2.line: 'The *shift* between sectors gives us exactly eleven seconds — use them.'

sentences.en: At 02:00 the power grid made its nightly *shift* — backup lines taking over, one sector at a time.
Grey Crow had memorized the pattern.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦已经记住了这个规律。

sentences.en: 'We have eleven seconds of full dark between sectors,' he said, pulling up the timing chart.
sentences.cn: 我们在各扇区之间有十一秒的完全黑暗，他拉出计时表说。

sentences.en: 'That is our door.'
sentences.cn: 那就是我们的门。

sentences.en: I set my watch.
sentences.cn: 我对了表。

sentences.en: Eleven seconds felt very short.
sentences.cn: 十一秒感觉非常短。

agree:2.en: 'We hand the file to the city council,' Ali said. Grey Crow looked at the rain-streaked window for a long time. 'They may already be compromised.' Ali did not blink. 'I know. But what else do we have?' A silence settled between them. Finally, Grey Crow nodded. 'I *agree*. We have nothing else.'
agree:2.cnHint: 面对危险的选择，灰鸦最终____了阿栗的提议，两人别无他法。
agree:2.hook: The moment he agreed, my communicator buzzed once — then went dead.
agree:2.line: 'I *agree* — but if this goes wrong, we lose everything.'

sentences.en: 'We hand the file to the city council,' Ali said.
sentences.cn: 我们把档案交给市议会，阿栗说。

sentences.en: Grey Crow looked at the rain-streaked window for a long time.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦长时间看着雨水模糊的窗户。

sentences.en: 'They may already be compromised.'
sentences.cn: 他们可能已经被渗透了。

sentences.en: Ali did not blink.
sentences.cn: 阿栗眼睛都没眨。

sentences.en: 'I know.
sentences.cn: 我知道。

sentences.en: But what else do we have?'
sentences.cn: 但我们还有什么？

sentences.en: A silence settled between them.
sentences.cn: 两人之间陷入了沉默。

sentences.en: Finally, Grey Crow nodded.
sentences.cn: 最后，灰鸦点了点头。

sentences.en: 'I *agree*.
We have nothing else.'
sentences.cn: 我们一无所有。

aware:2.en: I moved through the sub-basement slowly, certain I was alone. Then Grey Crow's voice came through my earpiece, barely a breath: 'Be *aware* — the motion sensors here are silent. No beep. No light. You will not know you triggered one.' I froze mid-step, one foot still in the air, and listened.
aware:2.cnHint: 灰鸦提醒我要____这里的移动感应器是无声的，触发了也不会有任何提示。
aware:2.hook: Somewhere ahead, a door clicked open on its own.
aware:2.line: 'Stay *aware* — this floor has eyes you cannot see.'

sentences.en: I moved through the sub-basement slowly, certain I was alone.
sentences.cn: 我缓缓穿过地下室，确信周围没有人。

sentences.en: Then Grey Crow's voice came through my earpiece, barely a breath: 'Be *aware* — the motion sensors here are silent.
No beep.
sentences.cn: 没有蜂鸣声。

sentences.en: No light.
sentences.cn: 没有灯光。

sentences.en: You will not know you triggered one.'
sentences.cn: 你根本不会知道自己触发了一个。

sentences.en: I froze mid-step, one foot still in the air, and listened.
sentences.cn: 我停在半步的地方，一只脚还悬在空中，仔细听。

relate:2.en: Grey Crow pulled a cracked data chip from the dead terminal and pressed it into my palm. 'Listen,' he said. His voice was flat, careful. He began to *relate* every detail of the blackout — the sequence, the timing, the hidden pattern. Each word landed like a cold drop of rain.
relate:2.cnHint: 灰鸦把停电的经过一一____给我听，每个细节都透着不寻常。
relate:2.hook: The last detail he named was my own address.
relate:2.line: 'I will *relate* what I saw, but you may not want to hear it.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow pulled a cracked data chip from the dead terminal and pressed it into my palm.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦从死机的终端里扣出一块裂纹数据芯片，按进我的掌心。

sentences.en: 'Listen,' he said.
sentences.cn: "听着，"他说。

sentences.en: His voice was flat, careful.
sentences.cn: 他的声音很平，很谨慎。

sentences.en: He began to *relate* every detail of the blackout — the sequence, the timing, the hidden pattern.
Each word landed like a cold drop of rain.
sentences.cn: 每个字都像冷雨滴一样砸下来。

attitude:2.en: Zero stood at the far end of the flooded corridor, arms loose, chin raised. That *attitude* — relaxed, almost bored — told me more than any words could. In Harbor City, the way a person holds their body is a language. And Zero was saying: I already won.
attitude:2.cnHint: 零点那副漫不经心的____让我意识到，他早就知道我会来。
attitude:2.hook: Then he smiled, and the lights went out again.
attitude:2.line: 'Your *attitude* tells me everything I needed to know.'

sentences.en: Zero stood at the far end of the flooded corridor, arms loose, chin raised.
sentences.cn: 零点站在淹水走廊的远端，胳膊松垂，下巴抬起。

sentences.en: That *attitude* — relaxed, almost bored — told me more than any words could.
In Harbor City, the way a person holds their body is a language.
sentences.cn: 在港口城，一个人怎么摆放身体就是一种语言。

sentences.en: And Zero was saying: I already won.
sentences.cn: 零点在说的是：我已经赢了。

fill:2.en: Ali cracked the sealed evidence box and tipped it over. Old paper notes, burnt wires, a single glass vial — they spilled across the floor. She took a slow breath, as if trying to *fill* herself with calm before speaking. 'This was not a power failure,' she said quietly.
fill:2.cnHint: 阿栗打开证物箱，深吸一口气，试图用镇定____自己，然后说出了真相。
fill:2.line: 'Take a breath — *fill* your lungs — because this changes everything.'

sentences.en: Ali cracked the sealed evidence box and tipped it over.
sentences.cn: 阿栗撬开了密封的证物盒，一倾而出。

sentences.en: Old paper notes, burnt wires, a single glass vial — they spilled across the floor.
sentences.cn: 旧纸条、烧焦的电线、一只玻璃小瓶——全散落在地板上。

sentences.en: She took a slow breath, as if trying to *fill* herself with calm before speaking.
'This was not a power failure,' she said quietly.
sentences.cn: "这不是断电，"她轻声说。

ignore:2.en: The warning signal had been blinking on my scanner for six minutes. I chose to *ignore* it, chasing the louder noise down the east corridor. When I finally turned back, the scanner was gone — lifted clean off my belt in the dark.
ignore:2.cnHint: 我____了扫描仪上的警告信号，结果付出了代价。
ignore:2.hook: Someone had been close enough to breathe on my neck.
ignore:2.line: 'You can *ignore* a signal once — not twice.'

sentences.en: The warning signal had been blinking on my scanner for six minutes.
sentences.cn: 扫描仪上的警告信号已经闪烁了六分钟。

sentences.en: I chose to *ignore* it, chasing the louder noise down the east corridor.
When I finally turned back, the scanner was gone — lifted clean off my belt in the dark.
sentences.cn: 等我终于转身，扫描仪没了——在黑暗里被人干干净净地从我腰间摘走了。

necessary:2.en: Grey Crow blocked the stairwell door with one arm. 'Only take what is *necessary*,' he said, eyes on the smoke rising from the lower floors. I dropped the extra drive, kept the chip, and ran. Every second we stayed, the building remembered us a little more.
necessary:2.cnHint: 灰鸦提醒我只带____的东西，烟雾已经从楼下涌上来了。
necessary:2.hook: Below us, something heavy began climbing the stairs.
necessary:2.line: 'Leave the rest — only the *necessary* things come with us.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow blocked the stairwell door with one arm.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦用一只胳膊挡住了楼梯间的门。

sentences.en: 'Only take what is *necessary*,' he said, eyes on the smoke rising from the lower floors.
I dropped the extra drive, kept the chip, and ran.
sentences.cn: 我丢了多余的驱动器，揣好芯片，撒腿就跑。

sentences.en: Every second we stayed, the building remembered us a little more.
sentences.cn: 我们在这里待的每一秒，这栋楼就多记得我们一点。

definitely:2.en: Ali spread the signal map under a flickering lamp. Three blackout zones, three nights, three coded messages — all pointing to the old port district. 'This is *definitely* not random,' she said, tracing the lines with one finger. The pattern was too clean. Someone had planned this long before tonight.
definitely:2.cnHint: 阿栗盯着信号地图，____地说这一切绝非偶然。
definitely:2.hook: The map showed a fourth zone — and it was ours.
definitely:2.line: 'This is *definitely* a message — and it is meant for you.'

sentences.en: Ali spread the signal map under a flickering lamp.
sentences.cn: 阿栗在闪烁的灯下铺开了信号地图。

sentences.en: Three blackout zones, three nights, three coded messages — all pointing to the old port district.
sentences.cn: 三个停电区，三个夜晚，三条加密信息——全指向老港区。

sentences.en: 'This is *definitely* not random,' she said, tracing the lines with one finger.
The pattern was too clean.
sentences.cn: 这个图案太干净了。

sentences.en: Someone had planned this long before tonight.
sentences.cn: 有人在很久之前就策划好了这一切。

forget:2.en: I found a name scratched into the wall behind the broken panel — my old partner's name. I had worked hard to *forget* it, to bury that case under new ones. But Harbor City has a long memory. The dust around the letters was fresh. Someone had written it tonight.
forget:2.cnHint: 我曾努力____那个名字，但它今晚又出现在了墙上。
forget:2.hook: Underneath the name was a single word: run.
forget:2.line: 'Did you really *forget* — or did you just stop looking?'

sentences.en: I found a name scratched into the wall behind the broken panel — my old partner's name.
sentences.cn: 我在破碎面板后面的墙上找到了一个名字——我老搭档的名字。

sentences.en: I had worked hard to *forget* it, to bury that case under new ones.
But Harbor City has a long memory.
sentences.cn: 但港口城的记性很长。

sentences.en: The dust around the letters was fresh.
sentences.cn: 字母周围的灰尘还很新。

sentences.en: Someone had written it tonight.
sentences.cn: 有人在今晚写的。

particularly:2.en: The data burst lasted less than two seconds, but three words surfaced in the noise — 'grid,' 'crow,' and one I could not decode. The third word was *particularly* strange: it matched no known cipher in the city registry. Ali went quiet when she saw it. That silence scared me more than the word.
particularly:2.cnHint: 数据噪音中有个词____奇怪，阿栗看到它之后沉默了。
particularly:2.hook: Ali had seen that word before — she just would not say where.
particularly:2.line: 'That one is *particularly* dangerous — do not say it aloud.'

sentences.en: The data burst lasted less than two seconds, but three words surfaced in the noise — 'grid,' 'crow,' and one I could not decode.
sentences.cn: 数据脉冲持续不到两秒，但三个词从噪音里浮出来——"网格""乌鸦"还有一个我解不了的。

sentences.en: The third word was *particularly* strange: it matched no known cipher in the city registry.
Ali went quiet when she saw it.
sentences.cn: 阿栗看到它的时候沉默了。

sentences.en: That silence scared me more than the word.
sentences.cn: 那种沉默比这个词本身更吓人。

land:2.en: The old data-vault sat beneath Harbor City, carved into solid rock — a place where no signal could escape. Grey Crow slid a cracked tablet across the table. 'This map shows a *land* beyond the city wall,' he said. 'That is where Zero hides the stolen code.'
land:2.cnHint: 灰鸦展示了一张地图，指向城墙之外某片____。
land:2.hook: No investigator had crossed that wall and come back.
land:2.line: 'The *land* past that wall is off every official map.'

sentences.en: The old data-vault sat beneath Harbor City, carved into solid rock — a place where no signal could escape.
sentences.cn: 老数据库埋在港口城下面，凿进了实心岩石里——一个信号逃不出去的地方。

sentences.en: Grey Crow slid a cracked tablet across the table.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦把一块裂屏平板推过桌子。

sentences.en: 'This map shows a *land* beyond the city wall,' he said.
'That is where Zero hides the stolen code.'
sentences.cn: "那就是零点藏偷来的代码的地方。"

promote:2.en: Ali held up a torn poster she had peeled from a subway pillar. It was a city broadcast, printed to *promote* a new 'Safe Speech' law — one that made half our working vocabulary illegal overnight. Someone had scrawled a single word across it in red: 'ZERO.'
promote:2.cnHint: 阿栗发现一张宣传____新法令的海报，上面被人写下了零点的名字。
promote:2.hook: Whoever wrote that name was either fearless or already gone.
promote:2.line: 'They use these posters to *promote* fear, nothing else.'

sentences.en: Ali held up a torn poster she had peeled from a subway pillar.
sentences.cn: 阿栗举起一张从地铁柱子上撕下来的破海报。

sentences.en: It was a city broadcast, printed to *promote* a new 'Safe Speech' law — one that made half our working vocabulary illegal overnight.
Someone had scrawled a single word across it in red: 'ZERO.'
sentences.cn: 有人用红笔在上面潦草地写了一个词："零点"。

purchase:2.en: In the flooded basement market, Grey Crow pointed at a receipt taped to a crate. 'Look at that *purchase*,' he said quietly. The item listed was a signal jammer — serial number matching the one that killed the grid in our district two nights ago.
purchase:2.cnHint: 灰鸦在地下市场发现了一张收据，显示有人____了信号干扰器。
purchase:2.hook: The buyer's name on the receipt was mine.
purchase:2.line: 'That *purchase* links someone to the blackout — and to us.'

sentences.en: In the flooded basement market, Grey Crow pointed at a receipt taped to a crate.
sentences.cn: 在淹水的地下市场，灰鸦指着贴在木箱上的一张收据。

sentences.en: 'Look at that *purchase*,' he said quietly.
The item listed was a signal jammer — serial number matching the one that killed the grid in our district two nights ago.
sentences.cn: 清单上的东西是一台信号干扰器——序列号跟两天前把我们那片区的电网搞瘫的干扰器一样。

rely:2.en: The backup terminal flickered. I had one chance to pull Zero's file before the power died again. Grey Crow pressed close and whispered, 'Do not *rely* on the city network — it is already compromised.' I switched to the isolated local drive and hoped he was right.
rely:2.cnHint: 灰鸦警告我不要____城市网络，因为它已经被入侵。
rely:2.hook: The drive spun — then produced a name I had never expected.
rely:2.line: 'We cannot *rely* on any system Zero has ever touched.'

sentences.en: The backup terminal flickered.
sentences.cn: 备用终端闪烁了一下。

sentences.en: I had one chance to pull Zero's file before the power died again.
sentences.cn: 我只有一次机会在断电前拉出零点的档案。

sentences.en: Grey Crow pressed close and whispered, 'Do not *rely* on the city network — it is already compromised.'
I switched to the isolated local drive and hoped he was right.
sentences.cn: 我切换到了隔离的本地驱动器，希望他是对的。

connect:2.en: Ali spread three evidence chips on the wet floor of the archive room. Each chip came from a different raid, different month. But a single faint thread of code ran through all three. 'If we *connect* these fragments,' she said, 'we get Zero's real broadcast address.'
connect:2.cnHint: 阿栗试图____三块证据芯片，以找到零点真正的广播地址。
connect:2.hook: The address, once revealed, pointed somewhere inside our own building.
connect:2.line: '*Connect* the last two chips — the pattern will appear.'

sentences.en: Ali spread three evidence chips on the wet floor of the archive room.
sentences.cn: 阿栗在档案室的湿漉漉的地板上摊开了三枚证据芯片。

sentences.en: Each chip came from a different raid, different month.
sentences.cn: 每一枚都来自不同的突袭，不同的月份。

sentences.en: But a single faint thread of code ran through all three.
sentences.cn: 但一条细微的代码线索贯穿了全部三枚。

sentences.en: 'If we *connect* these fragments,' she said, 'we get Zero's real broadcast address.'

indicate:2.en: A line of coded graffiti ran along the archive corridor wall. Grey Crow traced it with one finger. 'The symbols *indicate* a dead-drop point,' he said, 'active only during blackouts.' The next blackout was scheduled — or threatened — for midnight. That gave us forty minutes.
indicate:2.cnHint: 走廊墙上的涂鸦____了一个只在断电期间开放的秘密投递点。
indicate:2.hook: Forty minutes — and Zero almost certainly knew we were reading this.
indicate:2.line: 'These marks *indicate* the drop is live right now.'

sentences.en: A line of coded graffiti ran along the archive corridor wall.
sentences.cn: 一行编码涂鸦沿着档案室走廊的墙壁延伸。

sentences.en: Grey Crow traced it with one finger.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦用一根手指描过它。

sentences.en: 'The symbols *indicate* a dead-drop point,' he said, 'active only during blackouts.'
The next blackout was scheduled — or threatened — for midnight.
sentences.cn: 下一次停电定在——或者说威胁着——午夜。

sentences.en: That gave us forty minutes.
sentences.cn: 这给了我们四十分钟。

period:2.en: The file on the cracked screen listed a *period* of exactly nine days — the window during which all city surveillance had gone dark the previous winter. Grey Crow circled the dates. 'Zero built the whole network during those nine days,' he said. 'No cameras, no record.'
period:2.cnHint: 档案显示，零点在一段特定的____内秘密建立了整个网络。
period:2.hook: Nine days of darkness — and not one officer had noticed a thing.
period:2.line: 'That *period* of silence was not an accident — it was a plan.'

sentences.en: The file on the cracked screen listed a *period* of exactly nine days — the window during which all city surveillance had gone dark the previous winter.
Grey Crow circled the dates.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦圈出了日期。

sentences.en: 'Zero built the whole network during those nine days,' he said.
sentences.cn: "零点在那九天里建立了整个网络，"他说。

sentences.en: 'No cameras, no record.'
sentences.cn: "没有摄像头，没有记录。"

picture:2.en: Taped inside the locker was a small *picture* — a hand-drawn sketch of the harbor bridge, with three lampposts circled in red ink. Ali sucked in a breath. Those three posts had been replaced last week. New hardware, city contract, no public record. Grey Crow said nothing, but he was already moving.
picture:2.cnHint: 储物柜里藏着一张____，画出了零号在港口大桥上隐藏设备的位置。
picture:2.hook: Whatever was inside those lampposts had been listening for days.
picture:2.line: 'This *picture* was left here for us — or to trap us.'

sentences.en: Taped inside the locker was a small *picture* — a hand-drawn sketch of the harbor bridge, with three lampposts circled in red ink.
Ali sucked in a breath.
sentences.cn: 阿栗倒吸了一口气。

sentences.en: Those three posts had been replaced last week.
sentences.cn: 那三根柱子上周被换过了。

sentences.en: New hardware, city contract, no public record.
sentences.cn: 新硬件，城市合同，没有公开记录。

sentences.en: Grey Crow said nothing, but he was already moving.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦什么都没说，但他已经在行动了。

meanwhile:2.en: The signal cut at 02:00. Every screen in Harbor City went black. I found the drop point — a cracked phone taped under bench seven in the transit hub. *Meanwhile*, Grey Crow was feeding false data into the city grid three blocks away, keeping the watchers blind.
meanwhile:2.cnHint: 停电瞬间，我在中转站找到了暗号装置，而灰鸦____在别处牵制监控。
meanwhile:2.hook: The phone buzzed once, then the bench exploded in sparks.
meanwhile:2.line: '*Meanwhile*, you were being watched from the start,' Grey Crow said.

sentences.en: The signal cut at 02:00.
sentences.cn: 信号在02:00时中断了。

sentences.en: Every screen in Harbor City went black.
sentences.cn: 港湾城的每一块屏幕都黑了。

sentences.en: I found the drop point — a cracked phone taped under bench seven in the transit hub.
sentences.cn: 我找到了投递点——一部破损的手机用胶带贴在中转枢纽的第七张长椅下。

sentences.en: *Meanwhile*, Grey Crow was feeding false data into the city grid three blocks away, keeping the watchers blind.

damage:2.en: Inside the server vault, I swept my light across the rows of black boxes. The *damage* was deliberate — only the memory cores holding citizen voice files had been wiped, every other system left clean. Someone knew exactly what to erase.
damage:2.cnHint: 我在地下机房发现了有针对性的____，存储市民声纹的核心模块全被清除。
damage:2.hook: One box was still warm, its fan spinning in the dark.
damage:2.line: 'The *damage* points to someone with inside access,' Ali whispered.

sentences.en: Inside the server vault, I swept my light across the rows of black boxes.
sentences.cn: 在服务器保险库里，我用手电筒扫过一排排黑色的盒子。

sentences.en: The *damage* was deliberate — only the memory cores holding citizen voice files had been wiped, every other system left clean.
Someone knew exactly what to erase.
sentences.cn: 有人确切地知道要删除什么。

police:2.en: A coded tag covered the alley wall: three circles, one slash. Grey Crow had told me that symbol meant a raid was coming. The *police* drones had been rerouted here an hour ago, yet the alley was empty — the warning had arrived too late, or too early.
police:2.cnHint: 暗语涂鸦警告____无人机即将扫荡，但这条巷子里什么都没留下。
police:2.hook: A drone hummed overhead, its red eye sweeping lower.
police:2.line: '*Police* drones don't reroute without an order from the top,' Ali said.

sentences.en: A coded tag covered the alley wall: three circles, one slash.
sentences.cn: 一个编码标签覆盖了小巷的墙壁：三个圆圈，一道斜线。

sentences.en: Grey Crow had told me that symbol meant a raid was coming.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦告诉过我那个符号意味着突袭即将到来。

sentences.en: The *police* drones had been rerouted here an hour ago, yet the alley was empty — the warning had arrived too late, or too early.

race:2.en: Ali slid the data chip across the wet table. 'Thirty seconds before the backup signal dies.' It was a *race* between my fingers and the countdown — I had to copy the hidden frequency log before the chip self-wiped and took every name on it with it.
race:2.cnHint: 阿栗交给我一块芯片，我必须赢得这场____，在自毁前复制所有频率记录。
race:2.hook: Twenty seconds left — and the chip began to heat up.
race:2.line: 'This *race* has only one rule: don't lose,' Ali said flatly.

sentences.en: Ali slid the data chip across the wet table.
sentences.cn: 阿栗把数据芯片滑过湿漉漉的桌子。

sentences.en: 'Thirty seconds before the backup signal dies.'
sentences.cn: "还有三十秒备份信号就会断掉。"

sentences.en: It was a *race* between my fingers and the countdown — I had to copy the hidden frequency log before the chip self-wiped and took every name on it with it.

medical:2.en: The package Grey Crow left was labelled with a red cross and the words DISTRICT CLINIC. Inside, folded between two cold packs, was a *medical* record — not a patient file, but a list of frequencies disguised as dosage numbers, each one a stolen broadcast channel.
medical:2.cnHint: 灰鸦留下的包裹伪装成____物资，里面藏着用剂量数字掩护的频率列表。
medical:2.hook: The last frequency on the list matched the one in my skull.
medical:2.line: 'A *medical* label is the one disguise no scanner questions,' Grey Crow said.

sentences.en: The package Grey Crow left was labelled with a red cross and the words DISTRICT CLINIC.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦留下的包裹标着红十字和"社区诊所"的字样。

sentences.en: Inside, folded between two cold packs, was a *medical* record — not a patient file, but a list of frequencies disguised as dosage numbers, each one a stolen broadcast channel.

wear:2.en: Zero stepped out of the shadow at the far end of the corridor. I had expected a mask, a hood, something hidden. Instead the *wear* on Zero's face was open — deep lines, tired eyes — the look of someone who had been running this game far longer than I had.
wear:2.cnHint: 零点出现在走廊尽头，脸上的____出卖了他隐藏已久的疲惫。
wear:2.hook: Zero smiled anyway, and that was the most frightening thing.
wear:2.line: 'The *wear* on your face tells me you found the vault,' Zero said.

sentences.en: Zero stepped out of the shadow at the far end of the corridor.
sentences.cn: 零点从走廊远端的阴影里走了出来。

sentences.en: I had expected a mask, a hood, something hidden.
sentences.cn: 我原以为会看到面具、兜帽、什么被隐藏的东西。

sentences.en: Instead the *wear* on Zero's face was open — deep lines, tired eyes — the look of someone who had been running this game far longer than I had.

climate:2.en: The archive room smelled of old plastic and stale air. Every banned broadcast from the last decade was stored here, hidden inside climate data files. The *climate* readings were fake — each temperature log was a compressed voice message the city censors had never thought to open.
climate:2.cnHint: 档案室里的____数据文件其实是伪装——每条温度记录都藏着一段被审查的广播。
climate:2.hook: One file was dated tomorrow, and it was already playing.
climate:2.line: 'The *climate* files were the perfect hiding place,' Ali said softly.

sentences.en: The archive room smelled of old plastic and stale air.
sentences.cn: 档案室闻起来有旧塑料和污浊空气的味道。

sentences.en: Every banned broadcast from the last decade was stored here, hidden inside climate data files.
sentences.cn: 过去十年的每一条被禁播的广播都被存放在这里，隐藏在气候数据文件里。

sentences.en: The *climate* readings were fake — each temperature log was a compressed voice message the city censors had never thought to open.

head:2.en: The signal led me to a maintenance shaft at the top of the Meridian Tower. I climbed until the city spread below me like a circuit board. At the *head* of the shaft, bolted to the wall, was a small transmitter no larger than my fist — still broadcasting.
head:2.cnHint: 信号把我引向高塔顶端，在通道____位置，我找到一台仍在运行的微型发射器。
head:2.hook: The transmitter's light blinked: someone was listening live.
head:2.line: 'At the *head* of every signal is someone who wants to be found,' Grey Crow said.

sentences.en: The signal led me to a maintenance shaft at the top of the Meridian Tower.
sentences.cn: 信号把我领到了子午塔顶部的一条维修轴。

sentences.en: I climbed until the city spread below me like a circuit board.
sentences.cn: 我爬到城市像电路板一样在我脚下展开的地方。

sentences.en: At the *head* of the shaft, bolted to the wall, was a small transmitter no larger than my fist — still broadcasting.

return:2.en: The sub-station at Dock Nine had been dark for six hours. I found a folded note tucked inside the fuse box — a *return* address, burned at the edges, pointing to a warehouse three blocks east. Grey Crow had been here. The ink was still fresh.
return:2.cnHint: 我在配电箱里发现一张写有____地址的便条，墨迹未干。
return:2.hook: Someone wanted me to follow — but who left the trap?
return:2.line: Grey Crow said, 'The *return* address leads straight into Zero's territory.'

sentences.en: The sub-station at Dock Nine had been dark for six hours.
sentences.cn: 九号码头的变电站已经黑了六个小时。

sentences.en: I found a folded note tucked inside the fuse box — a *return* address, burned at the edges, pointing to a warehouse three blocks east.
Grey Crow had been here.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦来过这里。

sentences.en: The ink was still fresh.
sentences.cn: 墨迹还很新鲜。

remove:2.en: Ali pulled a corroded panel off the wall in the relay room. Behind it, wires had been cut clean. 'They did not just cut the power,' she said. 'They came to *remove* every trace of the signal.' Three cables hung loose, and the recorder was gone.
remove:2.cnHint: 有人故意____了信号的所有痕迹，中继室被清理得一干二净。
remove:2.hook: The blank wall stared back — whatever was here, it was taken.
remove:2.line: Ali whispered, '*Remove* the panel — there is something hidden behind it.'

sentences.en: Ali pulled a corroded panel off the wall in the relay room.
sentences.cn: 阿栗扯下了继电室墙上一块生锈的面板。

sentences.en: Behind it, wires had been cut clean.
sentences.cn: 面板后面，电线被齐齐剪断了。

sentences.en: 'They did not just cut the power,' she said.
sentences.cn: "他们不只是切断了电源，"她说。

sentences.en: 'They came to *remove* every trace of the signal.'

sentences.cn: 三根电缆松散地垂着，录音机没了。

colleague:2.en: A cracked data-pad lay on the floor of the server room. The last message on the screen read: 'Your *colleague* knows the frequency — ask before it resets.' I did not know who sent it. Ali was three floors up. Grey Crow had not checked in for two hours.
colleague:2.cnHint: 数据板上有人留言，提示我去问那位____某个关键频率。
colleague:2.hook: Two hours of silence — and Grey Crow's tracker had gone cold.
colleague:2.line: 'Your *colleague* is already inside,' the message read, 'and time is short.'

I did not know who sent it.

sentences.en: Ali was three floors up.
sentences.cn: 阿栗在楼上三层。

sentences.en: Grey Crow had not checked in for two hours.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦已经两个小时没有回复了。

normal:2.en: The corridor lights flickered back on at exactly midnight. Everything looked *normal* — clean floor, sealed doors, humming vents. Too normal. Ali grabbed my arm. The dust on the far door handle had been wiped away. Someone had passed through after the blackout began.
normal:2.cnHint: 走廊恢复____的样子，但门把手上的灰尘被人抹去了。
normal:2.hook: A clean handle in a dead building means only one thing.
normal:2.line: Ali said, 'Nothing about this place is *normal* — stay close.'

sentences.en: The corridor lights flickered back on at exactly midnight.
sentences.cn: 走廊的灯在午夜零点亮了起来。

sentences.en: Everything looked *normal* — clean floor, sealed doors, humming vents.
Too normal.
sentences.cn: 太诡异了。

sentences.en: Ali grabbed my arm.
sentences.cn: 阿栗抓住了我的胳膊。

sentences.en: The dust on the far door handle had been wiped away.
sentences.cn: 远处那扇门的把手上的灰被擦掉了。

sentences.en: Someone had passed through after the blackout began.
sentences.cn: 停电开始后有人经过了这里。

succeed:2.en: Grey Crow had tried three times to breach the locked archive terminal. His scratched notes lay scattered on the desk. Only the fourth attempt would *succeed*, he had written, if the failsafe was cut before dawn. Dawn was forty minutes away, and the failsafe light still burned red.
succeed:2.cnHint: 笔记显示只有第四次尝试才能____，而距离截止时间只剩四十分钟。
succeed:2.hook: Forty minutes, one red light, and no Grey Crow in sight.
succeed:2.line: Grey Crow wrote, 'We will *succeed* only if the failsafe dies first.'

sentences.en: His scratched notes lay scattered on the desk.
sentences.cn: 他潦草的笔记散落在桌上。

sentences.en: Only the fourth attempt would *succeed*, he had written, if the failsafe was cut before dawn.
Dawn was forty minutes away, and the failsafe light still burned red.
sentences.cn: 天亮还有四十分钟，故障保险的灯还亮着红色。

image:2.en: The projector in the abandoned press room clicked on by itself. It threw a single *image* onto the cracked wall — a map of Harbor City with one district circled in red. Zero's handwriting marked the edge: 'Here first.' Then the projector cut out and the room went black again.
image:2.cnHint: 放映机自动启动，将一张标有红圈的地图____投在墙上。
image:2.hook: The red circle sat over the one block we had never entered.
image:2.line: Zero's note read, 'Study this *image* — the answer is already drawn.'

sentences.cn: 废弃印刷室里的投影仪自己亮了起来。

sentences.en: It threw a single *image* onto the cracked wall — a map of Harbor City with one district circled in red.
Zero's handwriting marked the edge: 'Here first.'
sentences.cn: 零点在边缘写了字："从这里开始。"

sentences.en: Then the projector cut out and the room went black again.
sentences.cn: 然后投影仪熄灭了，房间再次陷入黑暗。

ourselves:2.en: We had sealed the stairwell door from the inside. 'We did this to protect *ourselves*,' Ali said, pressing her back against the cold steel. But the lock was a standard city model — Zero's crew would have a copy of the key. We had bought maybe five minutes.
ourselves:2.cnHint: 我们把自己锁在楼梯间里，试图靠____争取时间。
ourselves:2.hook: Five minutes — and we heard footsteps climbing toward us.
ourselves:2.line: Ali said, 'We can only trust *ourselves* in this building tonight.'

catch:2.en: I spotted a live feed on a cracked monitor at the end of the hall. The camera angle was wrong — pointed at the exit, not the room. Someone had tilted it to *catch* anyone leaving, not entering. A red dot blinked in the corner: recording, uploading, sending right now.

sentences.cn: 角落里有个红点在闪烁：正在录制、上传、实时发送。

international:2.en: The dead terminal in Sub-Level Nine still had one working port. I plugged in and found a single file: a route map marked *international*, tracing cargo lines between Harbor City and six ports I had never heard of. Grey Crow had warned me about this. Someone was moving more than goods.
international:2.cnHint: 我在废弃终端里发现了一份标注____的航线图，连接着六个陌生港口。
international:2.hook: One port on the map had no name — only a red X.
international:2.line: 'This *international* route,' Grey Crow said, 'did not exist last week.'

sentences.en: The dead terminal in Sub-Level Nine still had one working port.
sentences.cn: 九层地下的那台死终端还有一个能用的接口。

sentences.en: I plugged in and found a single file: a route map marked *international*, tracing cargo lines between Harbor City and six ports I had never heard of.
Grey Crow had warned me about this.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦曾经警告过我这个。

sentences.en: Someone was moving more than goods.
sentences.cn: 有人在运的不只是货物。

manage:2.en: The server room was flooding fast. Cold black water rose to my knees as I searched for the backup drive. I had two minutes before the whole grid went dark. Somehow I *managed* to pull the drive free just as the last light died above me.
manage:2.cnHint: 机房进水，我在黑暗降临前____取出了备用驱动器。
manage:2.hook: The drive was warm — someone had accessed it seconds before me.
manage:2.line: 'I don't know how you *managed* that,' Ali said, 'but we have to run.'

sentences.en: The server room was flooding fast.
sentences.cn: 服务器室进水很快。

sentences.en: Cold black water rose to my knees as I searched for the backup drive.
sentences.cn: 冰冷的黑水已经涨到我的膝盖。

sentences.en: I had two minutes before the whole grid went dark.
sentences.cn: 我只有两分钟才能全黑。

sentences.en: Somehow I *managed* to pull the drive free just as the last light died above me.

outside:2.en: Every screen inside the relay post had gone black. I pressed my face to the cold glass. The *outside* was worse: the entire east grid of Harbor City was dark, block after block swallowed by shadow, and somewhere in that dark a single red light blinked twice, then stopped.
outside:2.cnHint: 室内所有屏幕熄灭，____的情况更糟——整个东区陷入黑暗。
outside:2.hook: That blinking light was exactly where Zero said to never look.
outside:2.line: 'Stay inside,' Ali said. 'The *outside* is not safe right now.'

sentences.en: Every screen inside the relay post had gone black.
sentences.cn: 中继站里的每块屏幕都黑了。

sentences.en: I pressed my face to the cold glass.
sentences.cn: 我把脸贴在冰冷的玻璃上。

sentences.en: The *outside* was worse: the entire east grid of Harbor City was dark, block after block swallowed by shadow, and somewhere in that dark a single red light blinked twice, then stopped.

fun:2.en: Zero left a message burned into the fried circuit board, letter by letter in acid: 'Having *fun* yet, rookie?' Around the words, tiny symbols spelled out a frequency I recognised. It was the same signal Grey Crow had told me to forget. Zero knew what I had heard.
fun:2.cnHint: 零点在烧毁的电路板上留言，嘲讽我是否感到____，同时暗藏了一个危险频率。
fun:2.hook: The frequency was still live — and someone was broadcasting on it now.
fun:2.line: '*Fun* is over,' Zero's voice crackled through the speaker. 'I know where you are.'

sentences.en: Zero left a message burned into the fried circuit board, letter by letter in acid: 'Having *fun* yet, rookie?'
Around the words, tiny symbols spelled out a frequency I recognised.
sentences.cn: 字周围，一些小符号拼成了一个频率，我认得。

sentences.en: It was the same signal Grey Crow had told me to forget.
sentences.cn: 这是灰鸦告诉我要忘掉的那个信号。

sentences.en: Zero knew what I had heard.
sentences.cn: 零点知道我听到了什么。

reality:2.en: The encrypted map had looked like noise for three days. Then the pattern broke open and I saw the *reality*: it was a blueprint of Harbor City's power core, every switch and failsafe marked in red. Whoever drew this could kill every light in the city in under a minute.
reality:2.cnHint: 加密地图解开后，____令人震惊——那是整座城市电力核心的蓝图。
reality:2.hook: My name was written in the margin, in handwriting I knew.
reality:2.line: 'Face the *reality*,' Grey Crow said. 'We are already inside their plan.'

sentences.en: The encrypted map had looked like noise for three days.
sentences.cn: 那份加密地图看起来像噪音已经三天了。

sentences.en: Then the pattern broke open and I saw the *reality*: it was a blueprint of Harbor City's power core, every switch and failsafe marked in red.
Whoever drew this could kill every light in the city in under a minute.
sentences.cn: 谁画的这东西，能在一分钟内让整座城市断电。

beyond:2.en: The signal was strong until the old canal bridge, then gone. Equipment failure, I thought — until Ali pointed up. The bridge marked the edge of a dead zone that stretched *beyond* the visible skyline, a blank space on every map, as if that part of the city had been erased on purpose.
beyond:2.cnHint: 运河桥另一侧信号消失，那片区域____了所有地图的边界，像是被人故意抹去。
beyond:2.hook: Ali's hand gripped my arm and she did not let go.
beyond:2.line: 'What lies *beyond* that bridge,' Ali whispered, 'no one reports back about.'

sentences.en: The signal was strong until the old canal bridge, then gone.
sentences.cn: 信号一直很强，直到老运河桥那儿就没了。

sentences.en: Equipment failure, I thought — until Ali pointed up.
sentences.cn: 我以为是设备故障——直到阿栗指向上面。

sentences.en: The bridge marked the edge of a dead zone that stretched *beyond* the visible skyline, a blank space on every map, as if that part of the city had been erased on purpose.

completely:2.en: By the time we reached the archive room the files were gone — not deleted but *completely* rewritten, every line replaced with the same repeating phrase: 'YOU WERE NOT HERE.' The timestamp said the change had happened four seconds before we walked through the door.
completely:2.cnHint: 档案室的文件没有被删除，而是被____改写，时间戳显示就在我们进门前四秒。
completely:2.hook: The phrase was still typing itself, letter by letter, on the screen.
completely:2.line: 'It is *completely* gone,' I said. 'As if we never found it.'

sentences.en: By the time we reached the archive room the files were gone — not deleted but *completely* rewritten, every line replaced with the same repeating phrase: 'YOU WERE NOT HERE.'
The timestamp said the change had happened four seconds before we walked through the door.
sentences.cn: 时间戳显示改动发生在我们推门进去前四秒钟。

advise:2.en: A voice broke through the static on my earpiece, calm and low: 'I *advise* you to put the chip down and walk out the way you came in.' I did not move. The chip held three hours of Zero's transmissions. Whoever was speaking knew exactly what was on it.
advise:2.cnHint: 耳机里传来陌生声音，____我放下芯片离开，对方显然知道芯片里装了什么。
advise:2.hook: Behind me, the only exit clicked shut.
advise:2.line: 'I *advise* you,' the voice said, 'to make the right choice — now.'

sentences.en: A voice broke through the static on my earpiece, calm and low: 'I *advise* you to put the chip down and walk out the way you came in.'
I did not move.
sentences.cn: 我没动。

sentences.en: The chip held three hours of Zero's transmissions.
sentences.cn: 芯片里存着零点三小时的传输记录。

sentences.en: Whoever was speaking knew exactly what was on it.
sentences.cn: 不管谁在说话，他都清楚芯片里装的是什么。

mistake:2.en: The dead-drop point was a cracked vending machine on Level B3. I found the chip taped inside. But when I pulled the data, Grey Crow's face went pale. 'That chip belongs to Zero,' he said. Someone had made a *mistake* — and left the wrong package in the wrong place.
mistake:2.cnHint: 我在地下停车场找到了芯片，但灰鸦说这是一个____，东西放错了。
mistake:2.hook: The real chip — and its secrets — were already gone.
mistake:2.line: 'This *mistake* could get us both killed tonight.'

sentences.en: The dead-drop point was a cracked vending machine on Level B3.
sentences.cn: 死信箱在B3层一台破旧的自动贩卖机里。

sentences.en: I found the chip taped inside.
sentences.cn: 我在里面找到了贴着的芯片。

sentences.en: But when I pulled the data, Grey Crow's face went pale.
sentences.cn: 但我一拉数据，灰鸦的脸就白了。

sentences.en: 'That chip belongs to Zero,' he said.
sentences.cn: "这芯片是零点的，"他说。

sentences.en: Someone had made a *mistake* — and left the wrong package in the wrong place.

staff:2.en: The blackout hit at midnight. I pushed through the emergency exit into the server hall. Rows of dark terminals. No movement. Then a door clicked open — the building *staff* had not all gone home. One figure stood at the far end, watching me with a hand-held light.
staff:2.cnHint: 停电后我闯入服务器大厅，发现还有____没有离开。
staff:2.hook: The light swung toward me, slow and deliberate.
staff:2.line: 'All *staff* were ordered to leave — so who are you?'

sentences.en: The blackout hit at midnight.
sentences.cn: 停电发生在午夜。

sentences.en: I pushed through the emergency exit into the server hall.
sentences.cn: 我冲过应急出口进了服务器大厅。

sentences.en: Rows of dark terminals.
sentences.cn: 一排排黑暗的终端。

sentences.en: No movement.
sentences.cn: 没有任何动静。

sentences.en: Then a door clicked open — the building *staff* had not all gone home.
One figure stood at the far end, watching me with a hand-held light.
sentences.cn: 一个身影站在远处，拿着手电筒盯着我。

enhance:2.en: Ali slid a small circuit patch across the table. 'Clip it to your receiver,' she said. 'It will *enhance* the signal enough to decode the hidden layer.' I clipped it on. Static exploded in my earpiece, then, buried beneath the noise, a voice began to count down.
enhance:2.cnHint: 阿栗给了我一个装置，能____接收信号，让我听见隐藏的倒计时。
enhance:2.hook: Ten. Nine. Eight — then the voice cut to silence.
enhance:2.line: 'This patch will *enhance* your range, but only once.'

sentences.en: Ali slid a small circuit patch across the table.
sentences.cn: 阿栗把一块小电路贴片滑过桌子。

sentences.en: 'Clip it to your receiver,' she said.
sentences.cn: "夹在你的接收器上，"她说。

sentences.en: 'It will *enhance* the signal enough to decode the hidden layer.'
I clipped it on.
sentences.cn: 我夹上了。

sentences.en: Static exploded in my earpiece, then, buried beneath the noise, a voice began to count down.
sentences.cn: 静电在我耳机里炸开，然后，埋在噪音下面，一个声音开始倒计时。

famous:2.en: The file was labeled with a single name: Helios. Grey Crow tapped the screen. 'Helios was a *famous* signal-cracker, known across every dark network in Harbor City.' He paused. 'Was. Zero erased him three years ago.' I stared at the empty profile photo — a black square where a face should be.
famous:2.cnHint: 档案里的Helios曾是____的信号破解者，但已被零点抹去。
famous:2.hook: Someone had just sent me a message signed with his name.
famous:2.line: 'He was *famous* for breaking codes no one else could touch.'

sentences.en: The file was labeled with a single name: Helios.
sentences.cn: 文件标签上写着一个名字：赫利俄斯。

sentences.en: Grey Crow tapped the screen.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦点了点屏幕。

sentences.en: 'Helios was a *famous* signal-cracker, known across every dark network in Harbor City.'
He paused.
sentences.cn: 他停顿了一下。

sentences.en: 'Was.
sentences.cn: "曾经。

sentences.en: Zero erased him three years ago.'
sentences.cn: 零点三年前把他抹掉了。"

sentences.en: I stared at the empty profile photo — a black square where a face should be.
sentences.cn: 我盯着那张空的头像——一个黑方块代替了脸。

project:2.en: Deep in the archive I found a folder marked VOID. Inside: blueprints, budget sheets, a team list of thirty names. All crossed out. Ali leaned over my shoulder. 'That is the *project* Zero shut down five years ago,' she whispered. 'Nobody talks about it. Nobody who knows is still around.'
project:2.cnHint: 我在档案室发现了一个被零点中止的____，所有知情者都消失了。
project:2.hook: My own name was typed at the bottom of the team list.
project:2.line: 'The *project* was buried — but the data never was.'

sentences.en: Deep in the archive I found a folder marked VOID.
sentences.cn: 我在档案库深处找到一个标着"虚空"的文件夹。

sentences.en: Inside: blueprints, budget sheets, a team list of thirty names.
sentences.cn: 里面是蓝图、预算表、三十个人的团队名单。

sentences.en: All crossed out.
sentences.cn: 全都划掉了。

sentences.en: Ali leaned over my shoulder.
sentences.cn: 阿栗靠在我肩上。

sentences.en: 'That is the *project* Zero shut down five years ago,' she whispered.
'Nobody talks about it.
sentences.cn: "没人谈论它。

sentences.en: Nobody who knows is still around.'
sentences.cn: 知道的人都不在了。"

record:2.en: The disc was ancient, the kind no one used anymore. Grey Crow held it up to the blue emergency light. 'This is a *record* of every signal Zero ever broadcast,' he said quietly. 'Every frequency, every date.' In the wrong hands it was a map. In the right hands it was a weapon.
record:2.cnHint: 灰鸦找到一张____，上面存有零点所有广播信号的历史。
record:2.hook: Someone had already copied two tracks — and the copies were missing.
record:2.line: 'This *record* proves Zero has been watching us for years.'

sentences.en: The disc was ancient, the kind no one used anymore.
sentences.cn: 光盘很老旧，那种早没人用的类型。

sentences.en: Grey Crow held it up to the blue emergency light.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦把它举到蓝色应急灯下。

sentences.en: 'This is a *record* of every signal Zero ever broadcast,' he said quietly.
'Every frequency, every date.'
sentences.cn: "每个频率、每个日期。"

sentences.en: In the wrong hands it was a map.
sentences.cn: 落在坏人手里，这是一张地图。

sentences.en: In the right hands it was a weapon.
sentences.cn: 落在对的人手里，这是一件武器。

regular:2.en: Ali checked the log and frowned. 'Look at the timestamps.' I leaned in. Every seventy-two hours, without fail, a small data packet left this terminal — quiet, clean, invisible to a *regular* scan. Someone inside the building had been feeding information out for months, hiding in plain sight.
regular:2.cnHint: 阿栗发现每隔72小时就有数据包悄悄外传，普通的____扫描根本发现不了。
regular:2.hook: The next packet was scheduled to send in four minutes.
regular:2.line: 'A *regular* scan will miss it — you need deeper access.'

sentences.en: Ali checked the log and frowned.
sentences.cn: 阿栗查看了日志皱起了眉。

sentences.en: 'Look at the timestamps.'
sentences.cn: "看这些时间戳。"

sentences.en: I leaned in.
sentences.cn: 我凑过去看。

sentences.en: Every seventy-two hours, without fail, a small data packet left this terminal — quiet, clean, invisible to a *regular* scan.
Someone inside the building had been feeding information out for months, hiding in plain sight.
sentences.cn: 有人一直在从这台终端里偷数据，几个月来就这样藏在众目睽睽之下。

security:2.en: The door to the relay room had no handle, only a flat panel that read AUTHORIZED ONLY. Grey Crow crouched beside it and traced a thin wire running along the baseboard. 'They upgraded the *security* after the last breach,' he murmured. 'But they forgot one thing.' He pressed the wire and the panel went dark.
security:2.cnHint: 中继室的____系统被升级过，但灰鸦发现了一个被遗忘的漏洞。
security:2.hook: The door sighed open — and cold air poured out like a held breath.
security:2.line: 'Their *security* is tight — except for this one old wire.'

sentences.en: The door to the relay room had no handle, only a flat panel that read AUTHORIZED ONLY.
sentences.cn: 中继室的门没有把手，只有一块平面板，上面写着"仅限授权人员"。

sentences.en: Grey Crow crouched beside it and traced a thin wire running along the baseboard.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦蹲在旁边，顺着踢脚线上的细电线摸过去。

sentences.en: 'They upgraded the *security* after the last breach,' he murmured.
'But they forgot one thing.'
sentences.cn: "但他们漏了一样东西。"

sentences.en: He pressed the wire and the panel went dark.
sentences.cn: 他按了一下电线，面板黑了。

review:2.en: The archive room smelled of old rain and burnt wire. I spread the signal logs across the table for a *review* — three nights of blackouts, each one erasing a different city block. Grey Crow had marked certain entries in red. The pattern was not random.
review:2.cnHint: 我在档案室对信号记录进行____，发现断电并非偶然。
review:2.hook: The last red mark pointed straight to our building.
review:2.line: 'Do a careful *review* — every erased block hides a name.'

sentences.en: The archive room smelled of old rain and burnt wire.
sentences.cn: 档案室里弥漫着陈旧雨水和烧焦电线的气味。

sentences.en: I spread the signal logs across the table for a *review* — three nights of blackouts, each one erasing a different city block.
Grey Crow had marked certain entries in red.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦用红笔标记了某些条目。

sentences.en: The pattern was not random.
sentences.cn: 这个规律不是随意的。

ahead:2.en: Ali pulled me into a side tunnel beneath the power grid. The smell of burning cables was close. She pressed a small screen into my hand — a map with a blinking red dot moving *ahead* of us, two corridors away. Someone knew exactly where we were going.
ahead:2.cnHint: 阿栗给我看地图，那个红点在我们____方向移动，对方似乎掌握了我们的路线。
ahead:2.hook: The dot stopped — right where the tunnel ended.
ahead:2.line: 'They are *ahead* of us — change the route now.'

sentences.en: Ali pulled me into a side tunnel beneath the power grid.
sentences.cn: 阿栗把我拉进电网下方的侧道。

sentences.en: The smell of burning cables was close.
sentences.cn: 燃烧的电缆味道近得可怕。

sentences.en: She pressed a small screen into my hand — a map with a blinking red dot moving *ahead* of us, two corridors away.
Someone knew exactly where we were going.
sentences.cn: 有人确切地知道我们要去哪儿。
